Doosre design mein pehle se lagaya sealed electrical igniter bahar ke switch se activate kiya ja sakta hai.
Dono designs ka common rule kya hai?
Dekho, ignition ki energy andar pahunchni chahiye, lekin fresh outside air ka raasta nahi khulna chahiye.
Yeh teacher-controlled experimental designs hain, ghar par ignition task nahi.
points.screen: Plant-and-candle sealed jar with two alternative ignition diagrams: external focusing lens; preinstalled electrical igniter through sealed connections.
points.outside_book: Closed setup ko disturb kiye bina rekindling ke do possible experimental designs.
points.answer: Focused sunlight ya sealed electrical ignition candle ko jalane ki energy de sakte hain, bina outside air introduce kiye.
points.watch_out: Jar kholkar match le jaana air composition badal dega aur test ka inference kamzor karega.

says: Jan Ingenhousz, jinka jeevankaal 1730–1799 tha, ne agla sawaal poochha: kya sirf plant ka hona kaafi hai?
Unhone Priestley-jaise comparable setups ko darkness aur sunlight mein compare kiya.
Sunlight mein hi plant ka air-restoring process effective mila, jisse sunlight ki essential requirement establish hui.
Yahaan purifies the air ka matlab air ko phir candle burning aur animal breathing ke suitable banana hai.
Aksar log plant ko passive air filter samajh lete hain, par yahaan light-dependent biological activity result badalti hai.
Priestley ne restoration ka hypothesis diya; Ingenhousz ne us restoration ki sunlight requirement establish ki.
points.screen: Matched plant-and-candle jars under darkness and sunlight; sunlight-dependent restoration added to the evidence timeline.

terms.meaning: Yahaan air ko burning aur breathing ke liye phir suitable banana.

says: Ingenhousz ne aquatic plant, yaani water mein rehne ya ugne wale plant, se released gas ko visible banaya.
Green parts chlorophyll wale tissues hain; chlorophyll ka light capture hum pehle jod chuke hain.
Bright sunlight mein in green parts ke paas bubbles, yaani water mein gas ke chhote gole, bane; darkness mein yeh bubbling nahi mili.
Baad mein bubbles ki gas oxygen identify hui.
Sirf bubble dekhte hi oxygen kehna kyun theek nahi hota?
Dekho, bubble gas release dikhata hai, lekin gas ki identity alag test se establish hoti hai.
Is comparison ne dikhaya ki illuminated green parts oxygen release kar sakte hain.
points.screen: Same submerged aquatic plant in sunlight and darkness; close-up of green tissues, bubbles in sunlight, and collected gas identified as oxygen.

terms.meaning: Water mein rehne ya ugne wala plant.
Plant ke chlorophyll wale green tissues.
Water ke andar gas ke chhote gole.

points.outside_book: Gas release observe karne aur gas identify karne ke evidence ka distinction.

says: Sunlit aquarium mein submerged green vegetation par kabhi oxygen ke bubbles dikh sakte hain.
Water mein bani oxygen pehle dissolve bhi ho sakti hai, isliye har photosynthesising plant par visible bubbles milna zaroori nahi.
Bubbles na dikhne ka matlab photosynthesis bilkul band hai?
Dekho, gas water mein dissolved reh sakti hai, isliye visible bubbling akela universal measure nahi hai.
points.screen: Sunlit planted aquarium close-up with dissolved oxygen around leaves and occasional bubbles collecting on green surfaces.
points.outside_book: Aquarium observation aur oxygen dissolution ka explanation.

says: Air ki kahani ke baad sawaal tha: growing plant actual food kya banata hai?
About 1854 mein Julius von Sachs ne glucose production ka evidence diya.
Glucose ek sugar hai; usse starch banakar food store kiya ja sakta hai, jiska test hum kar chuke hain.
Unki later studies ne chlorophyll ko plant cells ke special bodies mein locate kiya, jinhe chloroplasts kaha gaya.
Chloroplasts cell ke andar chlorophyll rakhne wale photosynthetic compartments hain.
Green parts mein glucose formation aur starch storage milne se kya connection bana?
Dekho, green pigment ki cellular location ko food production aur storage se joda gaya; glucose banana aur starch mein store karna alag linked kaam hain.
points.screen: Sachs, about 1854: green leaf→cell→chloroplast containing chlorophyll; separate glucose production and glucose-to-starch storage arrows.

terms.meaning: Plant cells ke chlorophyll-containing photosynthetic compartments.

says: Ab light ki presence se aage poochhein: kya har colour photosynthesis ko equally drive karta hai?
Engelmann ke experiment mein teen kaam follow karenge: light ko colours mein baantna, alga ko illuminate karna, aur oxygen-seeking bacteria ka distribution dekhna.
Output ka indicator kya hoga?
Dekho, oxygen use karne wale bacteria jahaan zyada accumulate honge, woh regions greater oxygen availability aur photosynthetic activity ka evidence denge.
points.screen: Engelmann apparatus begins with white light, prism, green algal filament and initially dispersed bacteria; three-step path indicated.
points.outside_book: Aerobic bacterial accumulation ko oxygen availability se jodne ka explanatory mechanism.

says: T.W. Engelmann, jinka jeevankaal 1843–1909 tha, ne prism se light ke spectral components, yaani alag colour aur wavelength wale portions, separate kiye.
Unhone green alga Cladophora ko aerobic bacteria ki suspension mein rakha; suspension liquid mein dispersed organisms ka mixture hai.
Aerobic bacteria respiration ke liye oxygen use karte hain, isliye unki accumulation oxygen availability ka indicator bani.
O₂ evolution ka matlab molecular oxygen ka ban kar release hona hai.
Bacteria mainly blue aur red light wale algal regions ke paas accumulate hue; in regions mein oxygen evolution zyada thi.
Isse pehla action spectrum mila: alag wavelengths par photosynthesis kitni effective hai, uska pattern.
Yeh chlorophyll a aur b ke absorption spectra se roughly milta hai; absorption spectra pigments ka wavelength-wise light capture dikhate hain.
In dono pigments aur spectra ko aage detail mein kholenge.
points.screen: Same Engelmann apparatus now receives prism-separated spectrum; bacteria cluster near blue and red illuminated Cladophora regions, with oxygen-output pattern below.

terms.meaning: Light ke alag colours ya wavelengths wale portions.
Liquid mein dispersed chhote organisms ya particles ka mixture.
Respiration mein oxygen use karne wale bacteria.
Molecular oxygen ka ban kar bahar release hona.
Wavelength ke saath photosynthesis ki effectiveness ka pattern.
Wavelength ke saath pigments ke light absorption ke patterns.

says: Socho, phir aage badhenge: blue aur red regions mein bacteria ikattha hone se kya bacteria ke photosynthesis karne ka proof milta hai?
Dekho, photosynthesis Cladophora kar rahi hai aur bacteria uski released oxygen ko indicate kar rahe hain, isliye bacterial clusters algal photosynthesis ke effective light regions batate hain.
Kya yeh experiment directly pigment ka light absorption measure karta hai?
Dekho, yahaan biological output oxygen se activity infer hoti hai, jabki absorption spectrum pigment ki captured light ko measure karta hai.
points.screen: Cladophora labelled oxygen producer; aerobic bacterial clusters labelled oxygen indicators; action-output and absorption-input comparison.
points.answer: Alga oxygen banati hai; aerobic bacterial distribution us oxygen ka indicator hai. Yeh action evidence hai, direct pigment absorption measurement nahi.
points.watch_out: Bacteria ko photosynthesising organism ya blue/red light ko directly chase karne wala detector samajhna galat hai.

says: Nineteenth century ke middle tak central picture clear ho rahi thi: plants light energy se CO₂ aur water ko carbohydrate formation se jodte hain.
Carbohydrates sugars aur starch jaise organic food compounds hain.
Water ka formula H₂O hai; har molecule mein do hydrogen atoms aur ek oxygen atom hota hai.
Empirical equation observed overall inputs aur outputs ko compact form mein likhti hai: CO₂ + H₂O —Light→ [CH₂O] + O₂.
Yahaan [CH₂O] carbohydrate composition ka shorthand hai, poora glucose molecule nahi.
Glucose mein six carbons hote hain, isliye uski composition six CH₂O units ke equivalent hai.
Kya yeh short equation batati hai ki released oxygen kis reactant se aayi?
Dekho, CO₂ aur water dono mein oxygen hai, isliye sirf equation dekhkar us oxygen ka source decide nahi kar sakte.
points.screen: Water molecule labelled H₂O, with two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom; historical empirical equation with light above arrow; [CH₂O] expanded into six composition units.

terms.meaning: Observed overall input–output relation ki compact chemical equation.
Carbohydrate composition ka shorthand; glucose ka complete molecular formula nahi.
Sugars aur starch jaise carbon-containing food compounds.
Water ka formula; ek molecule mein do hydrogen atoms aur ek oxygen atom.

points.outside_book: Equations samajhne ke liye carbohydrates aur water ka molecular formula ab khola gaya.

says: Microbiologist Cornelius van Niel, jinka jeevankaal 1897–1985 tha, ne purple aur green bacteria se photosynthesis ki broader explanation nikali.
Unka sawaal tha: kya carbohydrate banane ke liye har photosynthetic organism ko same starting donor chahiye?
Is reasoning ke liye electron yaad karo, jise hum negative-charge wala particle keh chuke hain.
Oxidation mein substance electrons deta hai; reduction mein substance electrons leta hai.
Oxidisable compound aisa substance hai jo electrons dekar khud oxidised ho sakta hai.
Suitable compound se hydrogen ya reducing power milne par CO₂ reduces hoti hai, yaani electrons paakar carbohydrate banne ki direction mein badalti hai.
Yeh light-dependent process hai, yaani ise light ki zaroorat hoti hai.
Isliye photosynthesis ka broad principle light-supported CO₂ reduction hai; oxygen release har organism ki compulsory property nahi.
points.screen: Purple/green bacterial study leads to donor→reducing power→CO₂-to-carbohydrate schematic, with light input kept separate.

terms.meaning: Electrons dekar khud oxidised ho sakne wala compound.
Electrons receive karta hai; yahaan CO₂ se carbohydrate banne mein madad milti hai.
Jiske chalne ke liye light zaroori ho.

points.outside_book: Oxidation aur reduction ka basic electron-transfer prerequisite yahin introduce kiya.

says: Van Niel ki general equation hai: 2H₂A + CO₂ —Light→ 2A + CH₂O + H₂O.
H₂A variable hydrogen-supplying compound ka symbol hai; A us donor ke oxidised remainder ka symbol hai.
A ko fixed chemical element kyun nahi samajhna chahiye?
Dekho, donor organism ke saath badal sakta hai, isliye H₂A aur A general placeholders hain.
Equation mein do donor units ke saath ek CO₂ carbohydrate ki ek composition unit mein contribute karta hai aur water product bhi aata hai.
Coefficients molecules ya reaction proportions ginte hain; formula ke subscripts ek molecule ke andar atoms ki count batate hain.
points.screen: General donor equation with two H₂A units, one CO₂, two A units, one CH₂O composition unit and one product water; coefficient and subscript highlighted separately.

terms.meaning: Suitable hydrogen-supplying compounds ka general symbol.
General donor ka oxidised remainder; fixed element nahi.

points.outside_book: Coefficient aur subscript ka chemical-accounting prerequisite.

says: Hydrogen donor woh compound hai jo CO₂ reduction ke liye hydrogen ya reducing power supply karta hai.
Green plants mein donor H₂O hai; water oxidise hota hai aur O₂ milti hai.
Ab donor badalkar H₂S lo, yaani hydrogen sulphide, jise kuch purple aur green sulphur bacteria use karte hain.
In cases mein donor oxidation ka product organism ke according sulphur ya sulphate hota hai, oxygen nahi.
Simple sulphur-forming case ko likh sakte hain: 2H₂S + CO₂ —Light→ 2S + CH₂O + H₂O.
Kya light se carbohydrate banna aur oxygen release hona inseparable hain?
Dekho, donor badalne par oxidation product badal gaya, lekin light-supported carbohydrate formation phir bhi ho sakti hai.
points.screen: General equation branches into plant H₂O→O₂ donor case and sulphur-bacterial H₂S→sulphur/sulphate case; simple sulphur-producing equation below.

terms.meaning: CO₂ reduction ke liye hydrogen ya reducing power dene wala compound.
Hydrogen sulphide; kuch photosynthetic sulphur bacteria ka donor.

points.outside_book: General equation ka sulphur-forming H₂S substitution explicitly work kiya.

says: Donor badalne se released oxidation product badla, isliye van Niel ne inferred kiya ki green plants ki released O₂ water se aati hai, CO₂ se nahi.
Inferred ka matlab observations se reason karke conclusion nikaalna hai.
Inference ko direct proof se kaise alag karein?
Dekho, atoms ko pehchaan ka isotope label dekar unka destination follow karna isotopic tracing hai.
Classic oxygen-source proof mein stable oxygen-18 use hua; labelled water ki oxygen released O₂ mein mili, jabki labelled CO₂ ne released O₂ ko label nahi kiya.
Radioisotopic techniques radioactive isotopes ke decay signals se tracing karti hain, jaise pehle carbon-14 ke case mein dekha.
Oxygen-18 radioactive nahi hai, isliye is proof ko stable-isotope tracing kehna sahi hai.
points.screen: Paired tracer experiment: H₂¹⁸O leads to labelled released O₂; oxygen-labelled CO₂ does not label released O₂. Stable ¹⁸O contrasted with radioactive ¹⁴C.

terms.meaning: Observations se reasoning karke conclusion nikala.
Identifiable isotope se atoms ka pathway follow karna.
Radioactive isotopes ke decay signals se tracing; stable oxygen-18 tracing isse alag hai.

points.outside_book: Classic stable oxygen-18 tracer aur reciprocal labelling result; radioactive-oxygen claim ko correct kiya.

says: Ab full overall equation lo: 6CO₂ + 12H₂O —Light→ C₆H₁₂O₆ + 6H₂O + 6O₂.
C₆H₁₂O₆ glucose ka formula hai: ek molecule mein six carbon, twelve hydrogen aur six oxygen atoms hain.
Atoms ka hisaab dono taraf milta hai?
Dekho, left par carbon 6, hydrogen 24 aur oxygen 24 hain; right par bhi carbon 6, hydrogen 24 aur oxygen 24 hain.
Right-side oxygen mein glucose ke 6, water ke 6 aur oxygen gas ke 12 atoms judte hain.
Light energy input hai; woh carbon ya oxygen atoms supply nahi karti.
Input side par twelve waters hain, lekin six waters output mein bhi hain, isliye net water consumption six hai.
points.screen: Full photosynthesis equation with atom ledger C:6=6, H:24=24, O:24=24; output oxygen counted across glucose, water and O₂.

terms.meaning: Glucose formula: har molecule mein 6 C, 12 H aur 6 O atoms.

points.outside_book: Balanced equation ka worked atom ledger.

says: Socho, tumne canteen mein 120 rupees diye aur 60 rupees change wapas mila.
Cash counter ko diya amount 120 hai, lekin tumhara net kharcha 60 rupees hai.
Kya receipt par 120 dena aur net 60 kharch hona contradictory hain?
Dekho, total payment aur return alag record karne par dono amounts sahi samajh aate hain.
Equation mein twelve input waters total payment jaise hain, six product waters return jaise, aur six net consumed waters net kharche jaise hain.
points.screen: Canteen transaction: ₹120 paid−₹60 returned=₹60 net; aligned water ledger: 12 input−6 output=6 net.
points.outside_book: Gross aur net quantities ka numerical analogy.
points.answer: Total payment gross input hai; returned change product water hai; net expense net water consumption hai.
points.watch_out: Product waters ko unchanged original input molecules ka literal refund na samjhein; analogy sirf quantity accounting samjhati hai.

says: Ab twelve water molecules ko substrate side par kyun rakhte hain, jab net consumption sirf six hai?

Dekho, six O₂ molecules ke twelve oxygen atoms supply karne ke liye twelve waters ki oxidation ka gross account chahiye, aur CO₂-to-carbohydrate reduction accounting mein six waters dobara appear karte hain.
Electron ledger mein twelve waters se six O₂, twenty-four H⁺ aur twenty-four electrons milte hain.
Yahaan H⁺ positive charge wala hydrogen ion hai, aur e⁻ pehle samjhe electron ka symbol hai.
Six CO₂ ko glucose-equivalent mein reduce karne ka ledger yehi twenty-four electrons aur twenty-four H⁺ use karta hai, aur six waters product deta hai.
Dono accounts jodne par full overall equation milti hai; common product aur input waters cancel karne par net consumption six hota hai.
Yeh chemical accounting hai; released oxygen ka actual source isotope tracing establish karti hai.
points.screen: Same equation expanded into two accounting rows: 12H₂O→6O₂+24H⁺+24e⁻; 6CO₂+24H⁺+24e⁻→C₆H₁₂O₆+6H₂O. H⁺ labelled hydrogen ion; e⁻ labelled electron. Combine rows and cancel shared H⁺ and electrons.

terms.meaning: Positive charge wala hydrogen ion.
Electron ko equation mein dikhane ka symbol.

points.outside_book: Water oxidation aur CO₂ reduction ke balanced half-reaction ledgers; hydrogen-ion aur electron notation ka prerequisite.
points.answer: 12 gross water oxidation se 6O₂ aur reduction ke liye 24 electrons milte hain; reduction account 6 water output deta hai, isliye net water consumption 6 hai.
points.watch_out: Sirf oxygen atom balance se atom source prove nahi hota; six net waters ko gross oxygen-evolving water count na samjhein.

says: Is overall equation ka glucose product aur water-derived released oxygen ab alag roles mein clear hain.
Lekin kya ek arrow ka matlab ek hi chemical reaction hai?
Dekho, photosynthesis multistep process hai, yaani kai linked stages aur reactions milkar yeh total result dete hain.
Overall equation starting inputs aur final net relation batati hai; beech ki machinery aur reactions is ek arrow mein chhupi hain.
Un reactions ko samajhne ke liye ab unki working locations pehchaanani hongi.
points.screen: Previously built overall equation stays above; its single arrow opens into several connected, initially unnamed reaction stages within a green cell.

terms.meaning: Kai linked stages aur reactions se poora hone wala process.

says: Poora evidence jodo: Priestley ne air restoration ka hypothesis diya, aur Ingenhousz ne sunlight aur green parts se oxygen release ka connection establish kiya.
Sachs ne glucose production, chloroplasts mein chlorophyll aur starch storage ko joda.
Engelmann ne pehle light split ki, phir Cladophora illuminate ki, aur bacterial clusters se blue aur red regions ki greater activity pehchaani.
Van Niel ke variable donors ne oxygen ke water-source ki inference di, jise stable-isotope tracing ne support kiya.
Final matter ledger kya raha?
Dekho, six CO₂ aur twelve input waters se glucose, six product waters aur six O₂ ka overall balance milta hai; net water consumption six hai.
Light energy is multistep conversion ko drive karti hai, lekin atoms ka source reactants hi hain.
points.screen: Completed evidence timeline above a compact final ledger: carbon from CO₂, released oxygen from water, light as energy, 12 input water−6 product water=6 net.

parts.bridge: Ab experiments se pehchaane is multistep kaam ki jagah dhoondhenge: green plant ke kin parts aur chloroplast ke kin compartments mein photosynthesis hoti hai?
parts.title: EARLY EXPERIMENTS

parts.goal: Ab photosynthesis ke multistep kaam ko plant se chloroplast tak locate karenge, aur dekhenge ki uske alag compartments kaunse kaam sambhalte hain.

says: Ab photosynthesis ke multistep kaam ko plant se chloroplast tak locate karenge, aur dekhenge ki uske alag compartments kaunse kaam sambhalte hain.
Pehle humne chlorophyll ko chloroplasts mein aur photosynthesis ko kai linked reactions mein pehchaana tha.
Is spatial journey ke teen padaav hain: green organ, uske photosynthetic cells, aur chloroplast ke andar ke working regions.
Kya photosynthesis ki jagah sirf green leaf kehna kaafi hai?
Dekho, green leaves main sites hain, lekin photosynthetic machinery wale doosre green parts bhi yeh kaam kar sakte hain.
points.screen: Ek realistic green plant par leaf highlight ho; uske paas organ → cell → chloroplast ka teen-padaav zoom path.

says: Leaf ke alawa kaunse parts photosynthesis kar sakte hain?
Dekho, green stems, flower ke green sepals aur unripe green fruits mein bhi photosynthesis ho sakti hai.
Sepals flower ke baahar ke protective parts hote hain, jo aksar green dikhte hain.
Garden mein tomato plant ka green stem aur uska unripe green fruit dekho; leaf na hone se unki photosynthetic ability apne-aap khatam nahi hoti.
Pehle green tissues aur oxygen release ka sambandh dekha tha; yahaan bhi asal baat chlorophyll-containing machinery ki presence hai.
points.screen: Tomato plant ki leaf, green stem, flower ke green sepals aur unripe green fruit ke connected close-ups.
points.outside_book: Other-green-parts question ke concrete examples aur sepals ka basic meaning add kiya.
points.answer: Green stems, green sepals aur unripe green fruits possible photosynthetic sites hain.
points.watch_out: Har fruit ya har stem photosynthetic nahi hota; relevant green tissues mein machinery honi chahiye.

says: Ab leaf ke andar chalo: upper aur lower surface layers ke beech ka internal tissue mesophyll kehlaata hai.
Mesophyll cells mein bahut saare chloroplasts hote hain, jo usually cell walls ke saath position lete hain.
Incident light woh light hai jo kisi surface par aa kar padti hai.
Chloroplasts ka arrangement aisa hota hai ki unhe optimum, yaani kaam ke liye sabse suitable, light mile.
Optimum ko maximum kyun nahi keh rahe?
Dekho, chlorophyll ko light chahiye, lekin sabse zyada exposure har condition mein sabse beneficial nahi hota.
points.screen: Usi leaf ka cross-section mesophyll tak zoom kare; ek cell ke peripheral chloroplasts aur us par padta labelled incident beam dikhe.

terms.meaning: Leaf ki upper aur lower surface layers ke beech ka internal tissue.
Kisi surface par aa kar padne wali light.
Kaam ke liye sabse suitable amount ya condition; zaroori nahi maximum ho.

points.outside_book: Excessive exposure se protection ka basic context diya; detailed light damage aage aayega.

says: Ek mesophyll cell par light upar se neeche aa rahi hai; pehle beam aur cell ki upper wall dono mark karo.
Dim light mein chloroplast ka broad, flat face beam ke perpendicular rahe, toh woh zyada light intercept kar sakta hai.
Is geometry mein wahi flat face upper wall ke parallel bhi hai; dono descriptions ek saath sahi hain.
Ab light bahut strong ho jaaye, toh exposure kaise ghatega?
Dekho, side walls par edge-on positioning se broad face beam ke lagbhag parallel hota hai, isliye kam light intercept hoti hai.
Flat face side wall ke parallel ho sakta hai, lekin incident light ke perpendicular nahi hoga.
Isliye sirf wall-parallel yaad mat karo; kaunsi wall aur beam ki kaunsi direction hai, dono jodo.
points.screen: Ek hi realistic mesophyll cell ke dim aur strong light views; vertical beam fixed rahe, upper aur side walls mark hon, broad-face aur edge-on chloroplast positioning compare ho.
points.outside_book: Chloroplast accumulation aur avoidance positioning ko explicit beam–wall geometry se explain kiya.
points.answer: Dim light mein broad face beam ke perpendicular interception badhata hai; strong light mein side-wall, edge-on arrangement exposure ghataata hai.
points.watch_out: Wall ke parallel aur beam ke perpendicular opposite options nahi hain; relation wall aur beam ki geometry par depend karta hai.

says: Ab isi cell ke ek chloroplast ke andar dekho: internal membranes aur unke aas-paas fluid matrix alag regions hain.
Grana flattened membrane sacs ke stacks hain; in sacs ko thylakoids kehte hain.
Stroma lamellae unstacked membrane connections hain, jo grana ko jodti hain.
Stroma membranes ke aas-paas ka fluid matrix hai; yeh khud membrane system ka hissa nahi hai.
Stroma aur stroma lamellae ko alag kyun rakhna hai?
Dekho, stroma fluid working region hai, jabki stroma lamellae actual membrane connections hain; dono ki identity aur jobs alag hain.
points.screen: Usi chloroplast ka realistic cutaway: pehle membrane stacks highlight hon, phir connecting lamellae, phir surrounding stroma; teen labels spatially separate rahen.

terms.meaning: Flattened internal membrane sacs ke stacks.
Grana ke beech unstacked membrane connections.
Chloroplast ke internal membranes ke aas-paas ka fluid matrix.

points.outside_book: Flattened membrane sac ke liye thylakoid naam briefly introduce kiya.

says: Chloroplast mein division of labour hai, yaani ek bade kaam ke alag jobs alag working regions sambhalte hain.
Membrane system light energy trap karta hai aur ATP tatha NADPH banane ka kaam sambhalta hai.
ATP reactions ko usable energy supply karne wala molecule hai.
NADPH electrons dekar reducing power supply karne wala carrier hai; electron gain ko reduction hum pehle samajh chuke hain.
Dono ko ek hi cheez kyun na samjhein?
Dekho, ATP energy supply karta hai, jabki NADPH building reactions ke liye electrons deta hai; sugar synthesis ko dono tarah ki support chahiye.
Stroma mein enzymatic reactions, yaani enzymes ki madad se chemical changes, sugar synthesis karte hain; sugar se starch bhi ban sakta hai.
Enzymes biological catalysts hain, jo reactions ko tezi se chalne mein madad karte hain.
points.screen: Wahi chloroplast cutaway: membrane se ATP aur NADPH ke do distinct arrows stroma tak aayen; stroma mein sugar → starch ka chhota output branch bane.

terms.meaning: Ek bade kaam ke alag jobs alag regions mein hona.
Cellular reactions ko usable energy supply karne wala molecule.
Electrons dekar reducing power supply karne wala carrier.
Enzymes ki madad se hone wale chemical changes.

points.outside_book: Enzymes ki catalyst role aur ATP versus NADPH ke distinct roles ka prerequisite explanation diya.

says: Ek workshop socho, jisme solar-powered supply station aur assembly area alag work-zones hain.
Supply station energy packs charge karta hai aur assembly ke liye zaroori loaded tools ready karta hai.
Assembly area raw material ke saath in dono supplies ko use karke product banata hai.
Kya alag rooms mein hone se unke jobs independent ho gaye?
Dekho, assembly area ko supply station ke products chahiye, isliye physical separation ke bawajood dono milkar ek kaam poora karte hain.
Yahaan membrane system supply station hai, ATP energy packs hain, NADPH electron-loaded tools hain, aur stroma sugar banane wala assembly area hai.
points.screen: Do connected workshop zones ka simple picture; unke neeche matching chloroplast regions aur ATP/NADPH supply arrows dikhen.
points.outside_book: Division of labour aur functional dependence ke liye workshop analogy.
points.answer: Membranes supply station, ATP energy packs, NADPH electron-loaded tools aur stroma assembly area ko represent karte hain.
points.watch_out: NADPH mechanical tool nahi hai; woh chemical reactions mein electrons transfer karta hai.

says: Membrane system ke directly light-driven kaamon ko light reactions ya photochemical reactions kehte hain.
Photo ka matlab light hai, isliye photochemical naam light se directly chalne wale chemical changes ko batata hai.
Inka immediate role kya hai?
Dekho, yeh captured light energy ko ATP aur NADPH jaise useful chemical supplies se jodte hain; detailed mechanism hum aage kholenge.
points.screen: Wahi chloroplast cutaway: membrane region par light aaye; us region ko Light reactions / Photochemical reactions label mile, ATP aur NADPH arrows bane rahen.

terms.meaning: Light ki energy se directly driven chemical changes.

says: Stroma ke sugar-making reactions directly light-driven nahi hain, lekin unhe light reactions se bane ATP aur NADPH chahiye.
Inhe carbon reactions kehte hain, kyunki yeh carbon ko sugar banane ke kaam se jodte hain.
Dark reactions naam by convention, yaani pehchaan ke liye maana hua naam, diya gaya hai.
Ab socho, phir aage badhenge: kya dark naam ka matlab yeh reactions sirf raat ko chalti hain?
Dekho, dark ka matlab directly light-driven na hona hai, aur ATP tatha NADPH ki requirement ke kaaran inka light reactions par indirect dependence bana rehta hai.
Aksar dark reactions ko darkness ki requirement samajh liya jaata hai, par asal mein darkness inki zaroori condition nahi hai.
points.screen: Stroma ko Carbon reactions / Dark reactions label mile; light → membranes → ATP + NADPH → stromal sugar synthesis ka connected route highlight ho.

terms.meaning: Directly light-driven nahi, lekin light-reaction products par dependent reactions.
Carbon ko sugar formation se jodne wali reactions.
Pehchaan ke liye maan liye gaye naming practice ke according.

points.answer: Direct light driving aur indirect dependence alag hain; stromal reactions ko ATP aur NADPH chahiye, isliye dark naam night-only ya light-independent supply nahi batata.
points.watch_out: Dark reactions ko raat-only kehna galat hai; darkness unki requirement nahi.

says: Figure 11.2 chloroplast ka section hai, yaani andar ka arrangement dikhane ke liye cut-through view.
Yeh electron micrograph, electron microscope se mili structural image, ka diagrammatic representation hai: internal structure samjhaane wali simplified drawing.
Outer membrane envelope ki outer boundary hai, aur inner membrane uske andar ki doosri boundary hai.
Grana internal flattened sacs ke stacks hain; stromal lamella un stacks ke beech unstacked membrane connection hai.
Stroma in membranes ke aas-paas ki matrix hai; envelope, internal membranes aur matrix ko alag locate karo.
Ribosomes label chhote protein-making particles ko identify karta hai.
Starch granule stored carbohydrate ki inclusion hai, aur lipid droplet lipid material ki rounded inclusion hai.
Membrane light-work aur stromal sugar-work ko kahaan rakhoge; dekho, pehla internal membranes par aur doosra surrounding stroma mein fit hota hai.
points.screen: Figure 11.2 ka section eight leader labels ke saath progressively highlight ho: outer membrane, inner membrane, stromal lamella, grana, stroma, ribosomes, starch granule, lipid droplet; neeche figure identity caption.

terms.meaning: Internal structure dikhane wala cut-through view.
Electron microscope se bani microscopic structure ki image.
Structure ko clearly samjhaane wali simplified drawing.

points.outside_book: Ribosomes ka protein-making role aur lipid droplet ki basic identity briefly add ki.

says: Ab spatial journey phir jodo: green organ se mesophyll cell, aur wahaan se chloroplast ke andar aaye.
Chloroplast positioning suitable light exposure deti hai; internal grana aur connecting lamellae light-work ke membrane sites hain.
Ab aap sochoge, alag locations ke kaam aapas mein kaise judte hain?
Dekho, membranes light capture se ATP aur NADPH ki supplies banati hain, aur stroma unhe sugar synthesis mein use karta hai.
Sugar se starch storage judta hai; dark naam is connected system ko raat aur din ke independent departments mein nahi baantta.
points.screen: Ussi plant-to-chloroplast zoom ka uncluttered final map; chloroplast mein sirf membranes → ATP/NADPH → stroma → sugar/starch functional link prominent rahe.

parts.bridge: Ab light capture ki jagah mil gayi; agla sawaal hai ki wahaan kaunse pigments light pakadte hain aur leaf ka green colour kitne pigments ka mila-jula result hai.
parts.title: WHERE DOES PHOTOSYNTHESIS TAKE PLACE?

parts.goal: Ab light capture ki jagah se aage badhkar jaanenge ki leaf mein kaunse pigments hain aur unka light absorption photosynthesis se kaise judta hai.

says: Ab light capture ki jagah se aage badhkar jaanenge ki leaf mein kaunse pigments hain aur unka light absorption photosynthesis se kaise judta hai.
Membrane system ko hum light capture ka working region pehchaan chuke hain.
Ek hi plant ki leaves mein green ke itne shades kyun dikhte hain?
Dekho, visible colour pigments ke mixture aur unki relative amounts se juda hai; green leaf mein sirf ek pigment nahi hota.
Yahaan teen kaam karenge: pigments separate karna, unke light-absorption graphs padhna, aur absorption ko photosynthetic output se jodna.
Paper chromatography paper par mixture ke pigments ko alag bands mein separate karne ki technique hai.
points.screen: Ek plant ki different green leaves se green pigment extract aur paper strip tak connection; paas mein teen stages: separation, absorption, photosynthetic output.

terms.meaning: Paper aur moving solvent ki madad se mixture ke components ko alag bands mein separate karna.

points.outside_book: Leaf shades ko relative pigment amounts se jodna explanatory addition hai.

says: Teacher-supervised demonstration mein spinach leaf ka pigment extract paper par ek chhote starting spot ke roop mein lagao.
Paper ka lower end suitable solvent mein rakho, lekin pigment spot solvent level se upar rahe.
Solvent paper mein aage badhta hai aur pigments ko saath le jaata hai.
Pigments alag doori tak kyun pahunchte hain?
Dekho, solvent mein unki solubility aur paper ke saath attraction alag hoti hai, isliye ek green spot kai coloured bands mein separate hota hai.
Separation ko pigments ke weight ka seedha result samajhna galat hai.
points.screen: Spinach extract ka starting spot solvent level ke upar; solvent front aage badhne ke saath coloured bands dheere-dheere separate hote hain.
points.outside_book: Chromatography ka basic setup aur separation ka solubility–paper attraction basis samjhaya gaya hai.

says: Ab spinach extract ke separated bands ko unke colours se identify karo.
Chlorophyll a bright ya blue-green pigment hai, jabki chlorophyll b yellow-green pigment hai.
Xanthophylls yellow pigments hain; yahaan carotenoids wali entry yellow se yellow-orange pigments ko dikhati hai.
Aksar log sochte hain ki chlorophyll a yellow-green aur chlorophyll b blue-green hota hai, par asal mein a blue-green aur b yellow-green hota hai.
Kya yeh colours leaf ke andar bhi alag stripes mein hote hain?
Dekho, separation se pehle pigments saath present the; paper par bands unke mixture ko kholkar dikhate hain.
Ab inke names aur colours se aage, photosynthesis mein inke roles samjhenge.
points.screen: Separated spinach pigment bands ke saath colour swatches: chlorophyll a—blue-green; chlorophyll b—yellow-green; xanthophylls—yellow; carotenoids—yellow to yellow-orange.

terms.meaning: Chromatogram mein bright ya blue-green dikhne wala green pigment.
Chromatogram mein yellow-green dikhne wala pigment.
Leaf mein present yellow pigments.
Yellow se orange pigments ka broad group; xanthophylls bhi is broad family mein aate hain.

points.outside_book: Classification clarity: xanthophylls broad carotenoid family ka hissa hain; four chromatographic entries ko mutually exclusive chemical families nahi maana gaya.

says: Socho, keyboard par kai notes ek saath bajte hain aur tumhe ek combined chord sunayi deta hai.
Ab har key ko alag bajao, toh us combined sound ke individual notes pehchaan aate hain.
Kya pehle sirf ek hi note tha?
Dekho, notes pehle bhi saath maujood the; unhe alag sunne se mixture ke components samajh aaye.
Yahaan chord leaf ka combined colour hai, individual notes alag pigments hain, aur chromatography un components ko alag pehchaanne ka tareeka hai.
points.screen: Combined keyboard chord ke notes alag pehchaane jaate hain; saath mein green extract se separated pigment bands ka matching comparison.
points.outside_book: Musical chord analogy.
points.answer: Chord combined leaf colour hai; notes pigment components hain; individual notes pehchaanna chromatographic separation se components identify karne ke samaan hai.
points.watch_out: Pigment colour mixing aur sound combination ki physical mechanisms alag hain.

says: Pigment ko hum light capture karne wale coloured substance ke roop mein pehchaan chuke hain; important baat hai ki har pigment selected wavelengths absorb karta hai.
Wavelength light ki consecutive wave-crests ke beech ki distance hai; visible light ke alag colours alag wavelengths se jude hain.
Absorb karne ka matlab light ki energy apne andar lena hai.
Green pigment kya green light hi sabse zyada absorb karega?
Dekho, leaf green isliye dikhti hai kyunki green light ka relatively bada hissa reflect ya transmit hota hai, absorb nahi hota.
Ab guess karo, duniya ka most abundant plant pigment kaunsa hai?
Dekho, chlorophyll a most abundant plant pigment hai; abundance aur alag wavelengths ke absorption ko ab graphs se alag-alag samjhenge.
points.screen: Leaf par white light; blue/red absorption aur green reflection/transmission arrows; wave par consecutive crests ke beech wavelength mark.

terms.meaning: Light wave ki consecutive do crests ke beech ki distance.
Light ki energy ko substance ke andar lena.

points.outside_book: Green colour ka reflection/transmission basis aur abundance question ka explicit answer diya gaya hai.

says: Ab chlorophyll a ka wavelength-wise light capture graph par padhenge; absorption spectra ka basic meaning pehle Engelmann ke context mein mila tha.
Visible colours ka VIBGYOR order violet, indigo, blue, green, yellow, orange aur red hai.
Violet se red ki taraf wavelength generally badhti hai.
Graph mein horizontal axis wavelength aur vertical axis absorbance, yaani light absorption ka measure, dikhayegi.
Wavelength ke liye nm, yaani nanometre, use hota hai; ek nm, 10⁻⁹ metre hota hai.
Peak ka matlab kya hoga?
Dekho, curve ka higher region us wavelength par greater absorption batayega.
points.screen: Visible colour strip ke neeche 400–700 nm wavelength axis; vertical absorbance axis add ho, curves abhi na hon.

terms.meaning: Violet, indigo, blue, green, yellow, orange, red ka visible-colour sequence.
Light absorption ka measure.
Nanometre; 10⁻⁹ metre ki length unit.

points.outside_book: Graph-reading support aur nanometre conversion.

says: Figure 11.3a mein vertical label Absorbance of light by chloroplast pigments hai; numerical vertical scale nahi di gayi.
Chlorophyll a label ki cyan curve trace karo: maximum absorption ka colour kaunsa hai, aur doosra peak kahaan hai?
Dekho, prominent blue peak approximately 420–430 nm aur doosra red peak approximately 660–670 nm par dikhta hai.
Beech ke green-region wavelengths mein chlorophyll a ka absorption kaafi low hai.
Chlorophyll b label ki green curve mein blue peak near 460 nm aur smaller red peak near 645 nm hai.
Carotenoids label ki yellow curve mainly blue region mein, around 450–480 nm, absorb karti hai aur about 520 nm ke baad baseline ke paas aa jaati hai.
Curve ki drawing ka colour pigment ka actual colour nahi batata; pigment ko printed label se identify karo.
Different peak positions dikhate hain ki pigments same incoming light ke different portions capture kar sakte hain.
points.screen: Figure 11.3a ke same axes par pehle labelled chlorophyll a curve, phir b, phir carotenoids add hon; har peak wavelength colour strip se align ho.
points.answer: Chlorophyll a ke prominent absorption regions blue aur red hain; numerical peak readings approximate hain.
points.watch_out: Graph ink colour ko chromatographic pigment colour na samjhein.

says: Ab Figure 11.3b mein same horizontal wavelength positions par actual photosynthetic output dekho.
Vertical label Rate of photosynthesis, measured by O₂ release, hai; rate ka matlab fixed time mein hua photosynthesis hai.
Absorption spectrum pigment ka light capture dikhata hai, jabki action spectrum wavelength ke saath photosynthesis ki effectiveness dikhata hai.
Black curve blue region mein high hai, green se yellow-green region near 550–570 nm mein broad minimum par aati hai.
Phir red region near 680 nm mein high hoti hai aur 700 nm ke paas sharply girti hai.
Kya green region mein photosynthesis bilkul zero hai?
Dekho, curve intermediate wavelengths par bhi baseline se upar hai, isliye activity low hai, absent nahi.
Chlorophyll a ke high absorption aur high photosynthetic rate dono blue aur red regions mein milte hain.
points.screen: Panel a quiet rahe; aligned panel b mein O₂-release-based action curve blue peak se green minimum aur red peak tak trace ho; vertical rate label highlight.

terms.meaning: Ek fixed time mein photosynthesis kitna hota hai.

says: Blue aur red regions mein absorption aur activity ka correspondence chlorophyll a ki central role support karta hai.
Isliye chlorophyll a chief pigment hai, yaani photosynthesis mein main role wala pigment.
Chief ka matlab sole pigment kyun nahi hai?
Aksar log sochte hain ki chief pigment hone ka matlab sirf chlorophyll a hi kaam karta hai, par asal mein doosre pigments bhi light capture mein contribute karte hain.
Dekho, main role hona doosre pigments ke contribution ko cancel nahi karta.
points.screen: Blue/red matching spectral regions se chlorophyll a—chief pigment tak connection; baaki named pigments paas mein present rahen.

terms.meaning: Photosynthesis mein main role wala pigment; akela pigment nahi.

says: Figure 11.3c mein curves superimposed hain, yaani same wavelength positions par overlay karke compare ki gayi hain.
Legend mein black Rate of photosynthesis aur cyan Absorption, chlorophyll a ki curve, identify karte hain.
Horizontal label Wavelength of light in nanometres hai, jisme 400, 500, 600 aur 700 ticks hain.
Printed vertical label Light absorbed hai, lekin black curve legend ke according photosynthetic rate represent karti hai.
Dono curves blue aur red mein prominent response dikhati hain, par intermediate region mein black curve ka broad response cyan se match nahi hota.
Kya dono curves ki numerical heights ko same quantity samajhkar compare karenge?
Dekho, absorption aur photosynthetic rate different quantities hain, isliye yahaan wavelength-wise patterns compare karte hain, equal numerical heights nahi.
points.screen: Panel c mein black action curve aur cyan chlorophyll a absorption overlay; legend, vertical label aur 400–700 nm ticks visible; unmatched intermediate region highlight.

terms.meaning: Corresponding positions par curves overlay karke ek saath comparison dikhana.

says: Socho, phir aage badhenge: kya chlorophyll a absorption aur photosynthesis action spectrum ka complete one-to-one overlap milta hai?
Agar chlorophyll a ki absorption hi poora response samjha deti, toh intermediate region mein extra action response kyun dikhta?
Dekho, curves completely overlap nahi karti, aur yeh mismatch batata hai ki chlorophyll a ke apne absorption ke alawa bhi light capture ka contribution hai.
Is conclusion se chief pigment ki importance kam nahi hoti; ab uski madad karne wale pigments ka role khulega.
points.screen: Panel c ki intermediate wavelength band mein dono curves ke unmatched patterns; blue/red correspondence quietly visible rahe.
points.answer: Complete overlap nahi hai; other pigments ke light capture se bhi photosynthetic activity support hoti hai.
points.watch_out: Incomplete overlap chlorophyll a ko unimportant nahi banata, aur green-region activity ko zero bhi nahi batata.

says: Ab mismatch ka reason jodo: thylakoid membranes mein chlorophyll b, xanthophylls aur doosre carotenoids accessory pigments ki tarah kaam karte hain.
Accessory pigments main pigment ko support karne wale light-absorbing pigments hain.
Yeh different wavelengths absorb karke captured energy chlorophyll a tak transfer karte hain, isliye usable wavelength range badhti hai.
Yahaan pigment se pigment ko energy transfer samjho, electron ka wahi raasta nahi.
Blue aur red mein activity generally high hai, lekin doosri visible wavelengths bhi photosynthesis support kar sakti hain.
In pigments ka doosra fayda kya hai?
Dekho, yeh chlorophyll a ko photo-oxidation, yaani light-associated damaging oxidation, se protect bhi karte hain.
Isliye accessory pigments light capture ko broaden karne ke saath light-related damage se protection bhi dete hain.
points.screen: Realistic thylakoid membrane close-up mein named accessory pigments se chlorophyll a tak energy arrows; phir chlorophyll a ke paas protection symbol add ho.

terms.meaning: Chlorophyll a ko light capture aur protection mein support karne wale pigments.
Light se associated oxidation jo pigment ko damage kar sakta hai.

says: Prolonged darkness mein green leaf kabhi yellow ya pale green hone lagti hai.
Yellow pigment kya usi waqt naya aaya hai?
Dekho, yellow pigments pehle se present ho sakte hain, lekin dominant chlorophyll unka colour mask karta hai.
Lambe darkness period mein chlorophyll ka replenishment impair hota hai aur uski amount ghat sakti hai.
Relatively persistent carotenoids, including yellow xanthophylls, tab visible ho jaate hain; kuch chlorophyll bachne par leaf pale green lag sakti hai.
Is situation mein yellow pigments chlorophyll se relatively zyada stable dikhte hain, lekin iska matlab har pigment har condition mein equally persistent hona nahi hai.
points.screen: Same leaf ka green se pale-green/yellow comparison; pigment bars mein chlorophyll ghate, pehle se present yellow pigment contribution reveal ho.
points.outside_book: Prolonged darkness mein impaired chlorophyll replenishment, pigment masking aur yellow pigments ki relative persistence exercise foundation ke liye added hain.

says: Healthy shade leaf ki situation prolonged darkness se alag hai: shade mein light kam milti hai, bilkul gayab nahi hoti.
Same plant ki shaded leaves aksar sun-exposed leaves se darker green dikh sakti hain.
Kam light mein darker green kyun faydemand ho sakta hai?
Dekho, leaf available light capture karne ke liye pigment investment badal sakti hai, commonly tissue mass ke relative chlorophyll aur chlorophyll b ka proportion badhta hai.
Is adjustment se chlorophyll a:b ratio, yaani a ki amount ka b se comparison, kam ho sakta hai.
Pigment composition ka yeh adjustment shade acclimation hai; darker colour ka matlab automatically higher photosynthetic rate nahi hai.
points.screen: Same plant ki healthy shaded aur sun-exposed leaves; shaded leaf ke paas fewer incoming light rays aur relative chlorophyll b investment ka larger bar.

terms.meaning: Kam light ke according plant ki structure aur functioning ka adjustment.
Chlorophyll a ki amount ka chlorophyll b ki amount se comparison.

points.outside_book: Shade acclimation, relative pigment investment aur commonly lower chlorophyll a:b ratio exercise foundation ke liye added hain.

says: Poora investigation order mein jodo: green extract separate kiya, named pigment bands pehchaane, aur unke wavelength-wise absorption curves padhe.
Phir oxygen-release-based action spectrum se compare kiya; blue aur red responses strong the, lekin complete overlap nahi mila.
Ab aap sochoge, mixed pigments ka final fayda kya nikla?
Dekho, chlorophyll a chief role nibhata hai, aur accessory pigments additional light energy us tak pahunchakar usable wavelengths badhate aur damage se protection dete hain.
Ab agla sawaal hai ki yeh captured energy organised machinery mein chemical kaam shuru kaise karati hai.
points.screen: Compact connected sequence: pigment bands → absorption curves → action comparison → thylakoid pigments se chlorophyll a tak energy transfer.

parts.bridge: Ab pigments ki light capture samajh aa gayi; light reaction mein dekhenge ki unka organised arrangement captured energy ko ATP aur NADPH banane ke kaam se kaise jodta hai.
parts.title: HOW MANY TYPES OF PIGMENTS ARE INVOLVED IN PHOTOSYNTHESIS?

parts.goal: Ab pigments ki captured energy ko follow karke samjhenge ki light reaction ki organised machinery chemical kaam kaise shuru karti hai.

says: Ab pigments ki captured energy ko follow karke samjhenge ki light reaction ki organised machinery chemical kaam kaise shuru karti hai.
Photochemical phase wahi directly light-driven reaction set hai, jise hum membrane system par locate kar chuke hain.
Is phase mein chaar main events jodo: light absorption, water splitting, oxygen release, aur ATP tatha NADPH formation.
Water splitting aur oxygen release connected events hain; inka detailed mechanism aage kholenge.
ATP aur NADPH kyun banane hain?
Dekho, ATP usable energy aur NADPH reducing power supply karta hai, isliye captured light baad ki sugar synthesis ke kaam aa sakti hai.
points.screen: Realistic chloroplast cutaway mein thylakoid membrane highlighted; paas chaar simple event tiles: light absorption, water splitting, O₂ release, ATP + NADPH formation.

says: Yeh events several protein complexes ki madad se chalte hain; complex mein molecules ek organised working group banate hain.
Photosystem light collect karne aur photochemical event shuru karne wali pigment–protein unit hai.
Do distinct units hain: Photosystem I, ya PS I, aur Photosystem II, ya PS II.
Inmein light harvesting complexes pigments aur proteins ki light-collecting teams hain.
Kya PS I ka naam functioning mein pehle aane ka proof hai?
Aksar log sochte hain ki PS I pehle function karta hai, par asal mein I aur II discovery ka order batate hain, functioning ka nahi.
Actual electron route ko hum agle heading mein dekhenge.
points.screen: Usi thylakoid membrane ka molecular zoom: do separate pigment–protein units PS I aur PS II, dono mein light harvesting complex region highlighted; discovery-order tag dono names se linked.

terms.meaning: Light collect karke photochemical electron transfer shuru karne wali organised pigment–protein unit.
Photosystems mein light collect karne wale protein-bound pigments ke groups.

points.outside_book: Protein complex ko organised molecular working group ke roop mein briefly clarify kiya.

says: Ek light harvesting complex mein hundreds of pigment molecules proteins se bound hote hain.
Photosystem ke collecting pigments milkar antennae banate hain, yaani light-harvesting pigment network.
Is collecting network se special reaction-centre chlorophyll a ko alag pehchaano; reaction centre woh site hai jahaan excitation electron transfer shuru karati hai.
Aksar log sochte hain ki chlorophyll a sirf reaction centre mein hota hai, par asal mein antenna mein bhi chlorophyll a ke saath doosre pigments hote hain.
Itne pigments saath hone se efficiency kyun badhti hai?
Dekho, different pigments different wavelengths capture karte hain, aur pehle samjha accessory-pigment energy transfer us collection ko reaction centre tak pahunchata hai.
points.screen: Ek photosystem ka wahi molecular view: protein scaffold par many antenna pigments; unse alag reaction-centre chlorophyll a site; selected coloured light beams collecting pigments tak.

terms.meaning: Photosystem ka protein-bound pigment network jo light collect karke excitation energy reaction centre tak pahunchata hai.
Photosystem ki special chlorophyll a site jahaan excitation se electron donation shuru hota hai.

points.outside_book: Reaction centre ka functional meaning figure se pehle khola; antenna mein bhi chlorophyll a ki presence clarify ki.

says: Socho, chhat par ek badi collector dish weak incoming signal ko apni broad surface se collect karti hai.
Dish ka arrangement signal ko ek focal detector tak concentrate karta hai, jahaan useful electrical response shuru hota hai.
Badi collecting surface aur chhota detector alag jobs kyun kar rahe hain?
Dekho, broad collector signal pakadne ka chance badhata hai, jabki detector collected signal ko agle useful event mein badalta hai.
Yahaan dish antenna pigments ka network hai, focal detector reaction centre hai, aur signal ka focus hona excitation energy ka reaction centre tak pahunchna hai.
points.screen: Collector dish se focal detector tak converging signal paths; saath photosystem ke antenna se reaction centre tak matching energy paths.
points.outside_book: Collector dish aur focal detector ka everyday analogy add kiya.
points.answer: Dish antenna pigment network ko, focal detector reaction centre ko, aur converging signal excitation-energy transfer ko represent karta hai.
points.watch_out: Pigments actual dish ki tarah light reflect karke focus nahi karte; absorbed excitation energy molecular interactions se transfer hoti hai.

says: Figure 11.4, light harvesting complex, mein Photon label se shuru karo: photon light energy ka ek packet hai, jo peripheral pigment par aata hai.
Pigment molecules label collecting cluster ko identify karta hai.
Red zigzag route absorbed excitation energy ko pigments ke through Reaction centre tak jaate dikhata hai.
Excitation energy ka matlab light absorption se mili extra energy hai.
Reaction centre se upward blue arrow Primary acceptor tak electron donation dikhata hai; primary acceptor reaction centre ka electron sabse pehle leta hai.
Kya zigzag aur blue arrow ek hi cheez ka transfer dikhate hain?
Dekho, zigzag antenna mein excitation-energy transfer hai, jabki blue arrow reaction centre se acceptor ko electron transfer hai.
Electron donation se donor aur acceptor par alag charges bante hain; is charge separation se light capture ek chemical event se judta hai.
points.screen: Figure 11.4 ke labels Photon, Pigment molecules, Reaction centre, Primary acceptor sequentially highlighted; red excitation route aur blue electron arrow distinctly traced.

terms.meaning: Light energy ka ek packet.
Light absorb hone par pigment ko mili extra energy.
Reaction centre se donate hua electron sabse pehle receive karne wala molecule.
Electron transfer ke baad donor aur acceptor par alag electrical charges ka banna.

points.outside_book: Photon, excitation energy aur charge separation ke basic meanings electron-transfer figure samajhne ke liye add kiye.

says: Ab isi complex mein chlorophyll b ke ek peripheral molecule par absorbed photon follow karo.
Us absorption ki excitation energy antenna network ke through special chlorophyll a reaction centre tak pahunchti hai.
Uske baad acceptor ko electron kaun deta hai?
Dekho, reaction-centre chlorophyll a electron donate karta hai; peripheral chlorophyll b ki role yahaan energy collect karke centre tak pahunchane ki thi.
Is ek event mein photon ki energy ka contribution aur reaction centre se nikle electron ka route alag pehchaan mein aa gaya.
points.screen: Wahi photosystem view: ek chlorophyll b molecule highlighted; energy pulse network se centre tak, phir alag electron marker centre se acceptor tak.
points.outside_book: Figure ke generic peripheral pigment ko chlorophyll b maan kar ek concrete worked event follow kiya.

says: Dono photosystems ke special reaction centres ko ab unki characteristic absorption wavelengths se pehchaanenge.
Absorption peak woh wavelength hai jahaan absorption maximum hota hai; nm ki unit hum pehle khol chuke hain.
PS I ka centre 700 nm peak ke kaaran P700, aur PS II ka centre 680 nm maximum ke kaaran P680 kehlaata hai.
Kya alag peak names ka matlab alag pigment types hain?
Aksar log sochte hain ki P700 aur P680 alag pigment types hain, par asal mein dono special chlorophyll a centres hain.
Dekho, in names ke numbers characteristic peak wavelengths batate hain, pigment molecules ki count nahi.
points.screen: Usi membrane view ke PS I aur PS II centres par labels: PS I—chlorophyll a—P700—700 nm; PS II—chlorophyll a—P680—680 nm.

terms.meaning: Woh wavelength jahaan pigment ka light absorption maximum hota hai.
PS I ka chlorophyll a reaction centre, jiska characteristic absorption peak 700 nm hai.
PS II ka chlorophyll a reaction centre, jiska characteristic absorption maximum 680 nm hai.

says: Socho, phir aage badhenge: collecting antenna bahut strong ho, lekin uska functional reaction centre missing ho, toh light collection akeli chemical electron-transfer event chala degi?
Dekho, collection energy centre tak laati hai, lekin acceptor ko electron dene wali functional site ke bina collected energy required photochemical event nahi bana paayegi.
Antenna aur reaction centre complementary parts hain; zyada collection missing conversion site ka replacement nahi hai.
points.screen: Intact antenna mein energy pulses missing centre ke paas rukte; comparison mein intact centre se primary acceptor ko electron transfer.
points.answer: Antenna light capture karta hai, lekin functional reaction-centre chlorophyll a photochemical electron donation shuru karta hai; collection akeli us missing function ko replace nahi karti.
points.watch_out: Chlorophyll b ki abundance ko reaction-centre chlorophyll a ka replacement samajhna galat hai; collection aur photochemical conversion alag jobs hain.

says: Ab local sequence phir jodo: pehle antenna pigment photon absorb karta hai, phir excitation energy network se reaction centre tak pahunchti hai.
Reaction-centre chlorophyll a electron primary acceptor ko deta hai; energy transfer aur electron transfer ko alag rakho.
PS I ka centre P700 aur PS II ka P680 hai; I aur II discovery-order names hain.
Poore light phase ka result kis kaam se judega?
Dekho, water splitting aur oxygen release ke saath ATP tatha NADPH formation light energy ko baad ki carbon reactions ke liye usable supplies se jodti hai.
points.screen: Wahi photosystem picture par teen-step trail: photon absorption → excitation-energy transfer → electron donation; neeche quiet product strip ATP, NADPH, O₂.

parts.bridge: Ab reaction centre se electron acceptor tak aa gaya; agla sawaal hai ki electron transport mein woh kahaan jaata hai aur dono photosystems uske raaste mein kaise judte hain.
parts.title: WHAT IS LIGHT REACTION?

parts.goal: Ab reaction centre se nikle electron ka raasta follow karenge, aur samjhenge ki do light boosts use NADPH formation tak kaise pahunchate hain.

says: Ab reaction centre se nikle electron ka raasta follow karenge, aur samjhenge ki do light boosts use NADPH formation tak kaise pahunchate hain.
Reaction centre se primary acceptor ko electron donation aur P680–P700 ki identities hum pehle pehchaan chuke hain.
Yahaan teen padaav hain: PS II mein excitation, carriers se PS I tak transfer aur doosri excitation, phir final acceptor ki reduction.
Ek route mein light do baar kyun chahiye?
Dekho, beech ke transfers mein electron ki available energy ghatati hai, isliye aage reducing power banane ke liye PS I doosra boost deta hai.
points.screen: Realistic thylakoid membrane cutaway par PS II aur PS I ki positions; sirf PS II ke paas incoming light aur aage ke teen numbered route placeholders.

says: Raasta PS II ke P680 reaction centre se shuru karo, jise hum special chlorophyll a site pehchaan chuke hain.
680 nm red light absorb hone par electron excited hota hai, yaani higher-energy state mein pahunchta hai.
Isse nucleus se farther orbit mein jump ki simple picture se samajh sakte ho; molecular level par important baat higher-energy state hai.
Electron acceptor woh molecule hai jo doosre molecule se electron receive karta hai; yahaan pehla receiver primary acceptor hai.
Excited electron ka agla stop kya hai?
Dekho, acceptor electron receive karke use aage electron transport system ko hand over karta hai.
points.screen: Ussi thylakoid cutaway mein P680 par 680 nm light; paas ke energy inset mein electron higher level par jaakar PS II acceptor tak pahunchta hai.

terms.meaning: Energy milne par electron ka higher-energy state mein pahunchna.
Doosre molecule se electron receive karne wala molecule.

points.outside_book: Orbit picture ko molecular electron excitation ke higher-energy-state description se clarify kiya.

says: PS II acceptor se electron cytochromes wale transport system mein aata hai; cytochromes electron receive karke aage dene wale proteins hain.
Redox potential electron lene ya dene ki tendency ka measure hai; oxidation aur reduction ko hum electron transfer se jod chuke hain.
Chain mein transfer energetically downhill hai, yaani electron ki available energy ka kuch hissa release hota hai.
Aksar log sochte hain ki energy dene par electron kharch ho gaya, par asal mein electron carriers ke beech transfer hota hai, destroy nahi hota.
Yeh chain electrons PS I tak pahunchakar uske donated electrons ki replacement deti hai.
Saath hi PS I ka P700 centre 700 nm red light se excite hokar electron apne acceptor ko donate karta hai.
Kya PS I ko light ke badle sirf PS II se electron milna kaafi hai?
Dekho, replacement electron supply banaye rakhti hai, lekin second excitation ki energy PS I ko absorbed light se hi milti hai.
points.screen: Pehle cutaway par PS II acceptor se cytochrome-containing chain aur PS I tak electron arrows judte hain; ab P700 par 700 nm light aur doosre acceptor tak arrow ubharta hai.

terms.meaning: Electron receive karke aage transfer karne wale proteins.
Electron lene ya dene ki tendency batane wala measure.

points.outside_book: Downhill ko favourable energy transfer ke roop mein clarify kiya; redox potential aur electron energy ko ek hi numerical scale nahi banaya.

says: Socho, ek trolley ko pehli powered lift upar le jaati hai, phir woh descending ramp par neeche aati hai.
Ramp ke end par doosri powered lift use phir upar le jaati hai, taaki agla downhill route poora ho sake.
Kya pehla ramp paar karte hi trolley gayab ho gayi?
Dekho, trolley wahi aage pahunchti hai, lekin uski height se judi energy ghatati hai; doosri lift usse naya boost deti hai.
Yahaan trolley electron hai, dono powered lifts PS II aur PS I ki light-driven excitations hain, aur descending ramps carrier transfers hain.
Lifts ko power dene wali supply dono photosystems par absorbed light hai.
points.screen: Do powered lifts aur unke beech descending ramp par ek trolley; corresponding PS II, carrier chain aur PS I labels.
points.outside_book: Electron-energy changes ke liye trolley aur do lifts ki analogy.
points.answer: Trolley electron ko, lifts light-driven excitation ko, aur ramps downhill electron transfers ko represent karte hain.
points.watch_out: Electron ki energy spatial height nahi hai; electrons membrane mein literal lifts aur ramps par nahi chalte.

says: PS I acceptor ke baad electrons phir energetically downhill transfer hote hue final acceptor NADP⁺ tak pahunchte hain.
NADP⁺ electron receive karne ke liye available oxidised carrier hai; electron gain se iska reduction hota hai.
NADPH ko hum reducing-power supply karne wala loaded carrier pehchaan chuke hain.
Ek NADPH banane ka electron ledger hai: NADP⁺ + 2e⁻ + H⁺ → NADPH.
Kya ek electron milte hi ek NADPH ban jaayega?
Dekho, ek NADPH ke liye do electrons aur ek proton chahiye; electrons light-driven route se aate hain aur carrier mein reducing power jama hoti hai.
points.screen: Ussi membrane picture mein PS I acceptor ke baad NADP⁺ endpoint judta hai; side ledger par do electron tokens aur ek H⁺ se NADPH formation.

terms.meaning: Oxidised carrier jo electrons receive karke NADPH ban sakta hai.

points.outside_book: NADP⁺ reduction ki balanced half-reaction se two-electron aur proton requirement kholi.

says: Electron lekar agle molecule ko dene wala substance carrier kehlaata hai.
In carriers ko transfer ke order mein redox-potential framework par rakhne se poore route ki characteristic Z-jaisi profile milti hai.
Isliye ise Z scheme kehte hain: PS II ka light boost, chain ka downhill transfer, PS I ka doosra boost, aur NADP⁺ tak transfer.
Kya Z thylakoid membrane ka actual shape batata hai?
Dekho, Z electron-transfer energetics ka representation hai, membrane mein bana literal zigzag raasta nahi.
NADPH + H⁺ ki notation bhi milti hai; reduced carrier NADPH hai, aur saath likha H⁺ medium ka proton dikhata hai.
Carrier reduction ka chemical ledger wahi NADP⁺ + 2e⁻ + H⁺ → NADPH rahega.
points.screen: Membrane picture ke saath progressively bana energy/redox schematic: do light-driven rises aur do descending stretches; final NADP⁺ → NADPH label.

terms.meaning: Electron receive karke agle molecule ko transfer karne wala substance.
Do light-driven excitations aur carrier transfers ka characteristic Z-jaisa energetic representation.

points.outside_book: NADPH + H⁺ notation ko NADPH ki balanced formation reaction se alag clarify kiya.

says: Figure 11.5 mein left bracket Photosystem II aur right bracket Photosystem I identify karta hai; Light ki dashed arrows dono tak aati hain.
Dono LHC labels wahi light harvesting complexes hain, jo captured energy centres tak pahunchate hain.
PS II se upward electron arrow pehle e⁻ acceptor tak, phir descending arrows Electron transport system se PS I tak jaate hain.
PS I se doosra upward arrow uske e⁻ acceptor tak, aur final transfer NADP⁺ se NADPH formation tak follow karo.
Transport system ke paas ADP + iP → ATP label kya jodta hai?
Dekho, iP inorganic phosphate hai, aur yeh branch electron transport ko ATP formation se jodti hai; iska mechanism aage samjhenge.
PS II ke neeche H₂O → 2e⁻ + 2H⁺ + [O] shorthand hai, aur electron arrow PS II ko supply dikhata hai.
[O] ek oxygen-atom equivalent ka accounting symbol hai; released gas O₂ hoti hai, jiske liye do aise equivalents judte hain.
points.screen: Figure 11.5 ka clean labelled schematic, pehle dono photosystem routes highlight; phir ADP + iP → ATP branch aur aakhir mein water-input shorthand highlight.

terms.meaning: Light harvesting complex ka short form; protein-bound pigments ka group jo light pakadkar energy reaction centre tak pahunchata hai.

points.outside_book: ADP ko ATP formation ka precursor aur iP ko inorganic phosphate bataya; detailed phosphate addition agle subsection ke liye rakha.

says: Ab ek marked electron token ko P680 se follow karo: light excitation ke baad woh PS II acceptor, phir carriers aur PS I tak pahunchta hai.
PS I ki light-driven donation se electron flow doosre acceptor ki taraf badhta hai aur aakhir NADP⁺ reduction ko supply milti hai.
Token ki count beech ke carriers par kya hoti hai?
Dekho, har handover mein electron aage transfer hota hai, consume nahi hota; marked token electron continuity samjhata hai.
Ab do electrons ka batch lo: har electron ke liye PS II aur PS I ke excitation events jodne par minimum chaar reaction-centre photon events bante hain.
Yeh two-electron batch ek proton ke saath ek NADP⁺ ko ek NADPH mein reduce kar sakta hai.
points.screen: Pehle se bane route par ek marked token ka handover; chhote ledger mein 2 electrons, 2 PS II excitations + 2 PS I excitations, aur 1 NADPH.
points.outside_book: Ideal two-electron batch ke liye minimum four reaction-centre photon events derive kiye; actual absorbed light requirement losses se badh sakti hai.

says: Socho, phir aage badhenge: PS II electrons bhej raha hai, lekin PS I ko light na mile, toh kya NADPH formation ka yeh route continuously chalega?
Kya electron replacement aur electron excitation ek hi kaam hain?
Dekho, chain replacement electrons la sakti hai, lekin PS I ka light boost na hone par uske acceptor ki taraf sustained transfer rukega, isliye is route ki NADPH supply continue nahi hogi.
points.screen: Complete route mein PS I ki light input band; replacement arrow bana rahe, lekin PS I se acceptor aur NADPH endpoint ki flow indication ruk jaaye.
points.answer: Replacement electron supply aur light-driven excitation alag requirements hain; PS I excitation ke bina is route ka sustained NADP⁺ reduction nahi chalega.
points.watch_out: PS II se electron milna PS I ke photon input ka replacement nahi; electrons energy ke bina apne-aap second acceptor tak nahi bheje jaate.

says: Poora order phir jodo: P680 par 680 nm light excitation, pehla acceptor, cytochrome-containing chain, aur PS I tak electron supply.
P700 par 700 nm light doosra excitation deti hai; doosre acceptor ke baad electrons NADP⁺ reduction tak pahunchte hain.
Do electrons aur ek proton se ek NADPH banta hai; carriers mein electrons destroy nahi hote.
Do light boosts aur downhill transfers Z scheme ki profile dete hain, aur ATP formation ki branch bhi is transport se judi hai.
Ab PS II electrons deta rahe, toh uski apni electron kami kaun poori karega?
Dekho, figure ka water-input arrow isi replacement source ki taraf ishara karta hai; ab water splitting ka poora hisaab kholenge.
points.screen: Established route par order-wise gentle highlights; final focus PS II ke neeche water-input arrow par, baaki pathway quiet.

parts.bridge: Ab electron flow ko lagataar chalane ke liye PS II ki replacement supply chahiye; water splitting batayegi ki yeh electrons aur released oxygen kahaan se aate hain.
parts.title: THE ELECTRON TRANSPORT

parts.goal: Ab PS II ki replacement supply ko water splitting se jodenge, aur electrons, oxygen aur protons ka hisaab unki sahi location par rakhenge.

says: Ab PS II ki replacement supply ko water splitting se jodenge, aur electrons, oxygen aur protons ka hisaab unki sahi location par rakhenge.
Humne dekha tha ki PS II se electron transport chain PS I ko replacement electrons pahunchati hai.
Lekin PS II khud continuously electrons kaise supply karega?
Dekho, PS II ke donated electrons ki replacement water splitting se milti hai, isliye uski supply sirf pehle se maujood electrons par nahi tikti.
Yahaan teen baatein follow karenge: replacement ka route, products ka balanced hisaab, aur membrane par unki release location.
points.screen: Realistic thylakoid membrane cutaway mein PS II se carriers aur PS I tak pehle se jaana electron route faint rahe; PS II ke paas water input highlight ho.

says: Splitting of water woh process hai jisme water se electrons, H⁺ aur oxygen milte hain; yeh PS II se associated hai.
Is process ko photolysis bhi kehte hain: photo light ko aur lysis splitting ko batata hai.
Water ke electrons PS II ki electron kami poori karte hain, aur PS II transport chain ke through PS I ki kami poori karta hai.
Aksar log sochte hain ki water splitting PS I ko directly refill karti hai, par asal mein yahaan replacement route pehle PS II se guzarta hai.
Oxygen photosynthesis ke net products mein hai; net products poori process ka overall hisaab karne ke baad milne wale substances hain.
Pehle dekha [O] shorthand kya actual released gas tha?
Dekho, [O] oxygen-atom equivalent ka accounting symbol tha, jabki released oxygen gas O₂ hoti hai.
points.screen: Ussi membrane picture par water se PS II ki replacement arrow judti hai; PS II → carriers → PS I route highlight hota hai aur oxygen output alag nikalta hai.

terms.meaning: PS II-associated process jisme water se electrons, H⁺ aur oxygen milte hain.
Poore process ke overall input–output hisaab mein milne wale substances.
Light-driven machinery se judi water splitting; photo light aur lysis splitting hai.

points.outside_book: Water splitting ka alternative naam photolysis aur uske word-parts jode gaye hain.

says: Socho, ek chalti packing line par pehla worker token doosre worker ko deta hai, jo use aage dispatch kar deta hai.
Pehla worker har handover ke baad apne supply box se naya token leta hai.
Supply box band ho jaaye, toh continuous handover kyun rukega?
Dekho, pehle worker ka khaali token-slot refill nahi hoga, isliye downstream line ko regular supply nahi mil paayegi.
Yahaan supply box water hai, pehla worker PS II hai, beech ki line electron carriers hain, aur doosra worker PS I hai.
Tokens electrons hain; water se PS II ki replacement downstream electron supply ko chalne deti hai.
points.screen: Supply box → worker PS II → carrier line → worker PS I ka token-flow model; khaali slot aur refill ek-ek karke dikhte hain.
points.outside_book: Electron replacement ke liye packing-line analogy.
points.answer: Supply box water, tokens electrons, first worker PS II, connecting line electron carriers aur second worker PS I hai.
points.watch_out: Analogy replacement route samjhati hai; light excitation ki energy aur water ki chemical oxidation ko token handover represent nahi karta.

says: Ab do water molecules ka batch lo: 2H₂O → 4H⁺ + O₂ + 4e⁻.
H⁺ aur electron ke charges hum pehle khol chuke hain; 4e⁻ yahaan chaar electrons ki count dikhata hai.
Do H₂O mein total chaar hydrogen atoms aur do oxygen atoms hain.
Products mein chaar H⁺ aur ek O₂ molecule wahi atom-count sambhalte hain; chaar electrons electron-supply ledger mein aate hain.
Charge ka balance bhi milta hai?
Dekho, reactant water ka total charge zero hai, aur products ke +4 proton charges tatha −4 electron charges milkar zero dete hain.
Isliye har ek O₂ ke saath do waters ki oxidation se chaar replacement electrons aur chaar H⁺ milte hain.
Water electrons deta hai, isliye yeh water ki oxidation hai; light-driven machinery is electron extraction ko possible banati hai.
points.screen: Ussi PS II picture ke paas do water molecular models expand hon; 4 H⁺, 1 O₂ aur 4 e⁻ counted groups banen, saath atom aur charge ledger ho.

says: Ab products ki location samajhne ke liye usi thylakoid membrane ko cross-section mein dekho.
Thylakoid sacs ko hum grana ke building units pehchaan chuke hain; membrane se ghiri unki andar ki jagah lumen hai.
Bahar surrounding fluid stroma hai, jise hum pehle locate kar chuke hain.
Water splitting complex water oxidise karne wali PS II-associated machinery hai, jo membrane ke lumen-facing side par hoti hai.
Inner side ka matlab yahaan thylakoid lumen ki taraf wala face hai, poore chloroplast ki koi bhi andar wali jagah nahi.
Kya poora PS II lumen mein freely tairta hai?
Dekho, PS II membrane mein embedded complex hai, aur uska water-splitting apparatus lumen ki taraf face karta hai.
points.screen: Ussi realistic membrane cutaway mein lumen andar aur stroma bahar label hon; membrane-embedded PS II ka water-splitting complex lumen-facing surface par highlight ho.

says: Socho, phir aage badhenge: water-splitting machinery lumen-facing hai, toh bane H⁺ aur O₂ pehle lumen mein release honge ya stroma mein?
Apne jawab ko machinery ke face se jodo; sirf compartment ka naam yaad mat karo.
Dekho, reaction lumen-facing side par hoti hai, isliye H⁺ aur O₂ lumen side par release hote hain, jabki electrons PS II ki replacement supply mein jaate hain.
Kya oxygen wahin permanently band rahegi?
Dekho, O₂ baad mein diffuse karke bahar ja sakti hai; formation ki location aur final destination alag baatein hain.
Lumen mein mile H⁺ ka ATP formation se sambandh hum aage dekhenge.

points.answer: Lumen-facing water-splitting apparatus H⁺ aur O₂ lumen side par release karta hai; electrons PS II ko milte hain, aur O₂ baad mein diffuse kar sakti hai.
points.watch_out: Stroma ko release site na chuno: woh thylakoid ke bahar hai. PS I ko directly water-splitting electrons dena bhi replacement route ko galat karta hai.

says: Sunlit crop field se atmosphere mein pahunchne wali photosynthetic oxygen ka origin isi water oxidation mein hai.
Released oxygen ke water-source ka isotope evidence hum pehle establish kar chuke hain.
Ab us evidence ka mechanism kya mila?
Dekho, PS II-associated water splitting oxygen banati hai, isliye air ki oxygen supply ka sambandh leaf ke water input se judta hai, CO₂ ki oxygen nikaalne se nahi.

says: Poora connection jodo: PS II electron donate karta hai, aur lumen-facing water-splitting complex uski replacement supply deta hai.
Do waters se chaar electrons, chaar H⁺ aur ek O₂ milte hain; atoms aur total charge conserved rehte hain.
Electrons PS II ko milte hain, phir transport chain PS I ki replacement karti hai.
H⁺ aur O₂ lumen side par release hote hain; O₂ baad mein bahar diffuse kar sakti hai.
Water yahaan electron source hai, jabki photosystems ki excitation ko energy light deti hai.

says: Pichhli film mein humne dekha ki PS II ka khoya hua electron paani se aata hai.
Do paani ke molecule tootte hain, aur chaar electron, chaar H⁺ aur ek O₂ milte hain.
Usse pehle Z scheme mein electron ka poora safar dekha tha: paani se PS II, phir carriers ki kadi, phir PS I, aur aakhir mein NADP⁺.
Yaad rakhein: is safar mein electron ek hi disha mein chalta hai, paani se shuru hokar NADP⁺ par khatam.
Aage hum dekhenge ki yeh safar hamesha aise hi chalta hai ya nahi.
Ab socho: agar PS I ke aage NADP⁺ tak jaane ka raasta hi band ho, toh roshni se uchhla electron kahan jaayega? Aur kya tab bhi kuch banega?
points.screen: Z scheme ka raasta ek chalti line ki tarah: paani, PS II, carriers ki kadi, PS I, NADP⁺; paani ke do molecule toot kar 4 e⁻, 4 H⁺ aur ek O₂; yaad rakhein: electron ek hi disha mein, paani se NADP⁺ tak (ek teer); aakhri line par PS I ke aage NADP⁺ wala raasta band.

says: Is sawaal ka jawab isi film mein milega. Par usse pehle ek zaroori cheez pakki kar lo: ATP.
Har jeev ko kaam ke liye energy chahiye: saans lene ke liye, chalne ke liye, ek naya molecule banane ke liye.
Yeh energy jeev kuch cheezon se nikaalte hain, jaise khaane ka glucose.
Yaad karo, oxidation ka matlab hai electron dena, aur reduction ka matlab hai electron lena.
Jo cheezein oxidation mein electron de sakti hain, unhe oxidisable substances kehte hain. Glucose aisi hi ek cheez hai.
Glucose se energy kaise nikalti hai, yeh aap aage respiration wale chapter mein padhoge. Abhi bas itna jaan lo ki aisi cheezon se energy nikalti hai.
Nikli hui energy jeev turant kharch nahi karte. Use molecules ke andar band karke rakh lete hain.
Band karke isliye rakhte hain kyunki energy ki zaroorat har jagah aur har pal hoti hai, aur band energy ko jahan chaaho wahan le ja sakte ho.
Socho ek gulel, jiski rubber ko kheench kar pakad liya. Energy us khinchi hui rubber mein band hai; chhodoge toh kaam karegi.
Molecule mein atom aapas mein bandhanon se jude hote hain, jinhe chemical bonds kehte hain. In bonds mein bhi aise hi energy band rehti hai; ise bond energy kehte hain.
ATP ek aisa hi khaas molecule hai. Yeh apne chemical bonds mein energy lekar chalta hai, aur cell ke har kaam tak pahunchata hai.
ATP ka poora naam hai adenosine triphosphate. Tri yaani teen, toh isme teen phosphate jude hain.
ADP yaani adenosine diphosphate. Di yaani do, toh isme do hi phosphate hain.
ATP ko ek bhari hui battery samjho, aur ADP ko ek khaali hoti battery.
Khaali battery ko phir se bharna hai, toh ADP mein ek phosphate aur jodna padta hai. Aur is jodne mein energy lagti hai.
Jo phosphate akela hai, kisi molecule se juda nahi, use inorganic phosphate kehte hain. Chhote mein ise Pᵢ likhte hain; i yaani inorganic.
ADP mein phosphate jodkar ATP banane ko phosphorylation kehte hain. Phosphate jodna, isliye naam phosphorylation.
Cell yeh kaam do jagah karta hai: mitochondria mein aur chloroplast mein.
Mitochondria wala tareeka bhi aap respiration wale chapter mein padhoge. Hamari kahani chloroplast ki hai.
Chloroplast mein yeh charging roshni se hoti hai, bilkul waise jaise solar charger dhoop se phone charge karta hai.
Roshni ki madad se ADP aur inorganic phosphate se ATP banane ko photo-phosphorylation kehte hain, kyunki photo ka matlab hi roshni hai.
points.screen: Energy ki zaroorat ke chhote drishya (saans, chalna, naya molecule); glucose se energy; oxidation = electron dena, reduction = electron lena; gulel ki khinchi rubber (apni tasveer); atomon ke beech chemical bond mein band energy; ATP: adenosine ke saath teen phosphate, ADP: do phosphate; bhari aur khaali battery (apni tasveer); ADP + Pᵢ → ATP, jodne mein energy; mitochondria aur chloroplast; dhoop se phone bharta solar charger (apni tasveer); roshni ke saath ADP + Pᵢ → ATP.
