says: Ab Figure 11.5 wali Z scheme yaad karo, jo hum pehle padh chuke hain.
Usme do photosystem the: pehle PS II, phir PS I. Dono par roshni padti thi.
Dono ke beech carriers ki ek kadi thi, jo electron ko ek se doosre tak aage deti hai.
Is kadi ko electron transport chain kehte hain: electron ka transport, yaani le jaana, ek chain mein.
Ise ek relay daud ki tarah socho. Har khiladi baton ko agle khiladi ke haath mein deta hai, aur baton aage badhta jaata hai.
Yahan baton hai electron, aur khiladi hain carriers. Roshni do jagah zor ka dhakka deti hai: PS II par aur PS I par.
Is daud mein baton paani se chalta hai. PS II aur PS I se hokar, aakhir mein NADP⁺ ke haath mein pahunchta hai.
NADP⁺ electron le leta hai aur NADPH ban jaata hai. Baton wahin ruk gaya; woh wapas shuru par nahi aata.
Toh is raaste mein do cheezein banti hain: ATP aur NADPH. Saath mein paani tootne se O₂ bhi nikalti hai.
Aksar ise NADPH + H⁺ likhte hain. Iska matlab bas itna hai ki NADPH ke saath ek H⁺ bhi likha jaata hai.
Dhyan do, electron ek seedhe raaste par aage gaya, aur jahan se chala tha wahan wapas nahi lauta. Raasta gol nahi hai.
Isliye ise non-cyclic photo-phosphorylation kehte hain. Cyclic yaani gol chakkar wala, aur non-cyclic yaani jo gol chakkar na ho.
Yaad rakho: non-cyclic mein dono photosystem ek ke baad ek kaam karte hain, pehle PS II, phir PS I. Aur ATP ke saath NADPH bhi banta hai.
Yahan exam ki ek baareek baat hai: naam PS I hai, par kaam mein woh doosre number par aata hai.
Number kaam ke kram se nahi pade; PS I pehle khoja gaya tha, isliye uska naam I pada.
points.screen: Z scheme: PS II aur PS I, dono par roshni, beech mein carriers ki kadi; relay daud (apni tasveer): baton electron, khiladi carriers; electron paani se NADP⁺ tak pahunch kar NADPH; ATP, NADPH aur O₂; seedha raasta jo shuru par wapas nahi aata; kaam ka kram PS II pehle, PS I baad mein, aur naam ka kram khoj se (PS I pehle khoja gaya).
points.watch_out: Yeh sochna ki PS I pehle kaam karta hai kyunki uska number pehla hai.
points.outside_book: PS I aur PS II ke naam khoj ke kram se pade, yeh kitaab mein nahi; exam ki baareek baat ke roop mein joda.

says: Ab Figure 11.6 dekho. Yahan ek bilkul alag raasta hai.
Sabse upar bracket mein likha hai Photosystem I. Matlab is figure mein sirf PS I ka kaam dikhaya gaya hai; ise kahin-kahin PSI bhi likha milta hai.
Neeche likha hai Chlorophyll P 700. Yeh PS I ka reaction centre hai, jo lagbhag 700 nm ki roshni pakadta hai.
Peeli dashed teer par Light likha hai. Roshni seedhe P 700 par padti hai.
Roshni padte hi P 700 ka electron energy lekar uchhalta hai. Ungli rakho: gulabi teer seedhe upar e⁻ acceptor tak jaata hai.
e⁻ electron ka nishaan hai. Aur e⁻ acceptor woh molecule hai jo uchhla hua electron sabse pehle pakadta hai.
Ab acceptor se ek mudi hui gulabi teer neeche Electron transport system tak aati hai. Yeh carriers ki wahi kadi hai.
Ab ungli aage le chalo. Is kadi ke baad gulabi teer kahan jaati hai?
Is kadi ke baad gulabi teer wapas P 700 par hi pahunchti hai, wahin jahan se electron chala tha.
Electron ne ek gol chakkar poora kiya: P 700 se acceptor, phir kadi, phir wapas P 700. Isi gol chakkar ki wajah se ise cyclic kehte hain.
Relay wali daud yaad hai? Yahan baton kisi ko diya hi nahi gaya. Khiladi track ka ek chakkar lagakar wahin laut aaya jahan se chala tha.
Ab kadi ke paas ek kaali mudi teer dekho: ADP + Pi se ATP. Yaani is chakkar ke saath ATP banta hai.
Isliye ise cyclic photophosphorylation kehte hain: roshni se, ek gol chakkar ke saath, ATP banana.
Aur yeh bhi dekho ki figure mein kya nahi hai: na PS II hai, na NADP⁺ tak jaane wala raasta.
points.screen: Cyclic photophosphorylation ka figure jaisa drishya, har label tabhi jab line uska naam le: Photosystem I bracket, Chlorophyll P 700, Light ki peeli dashed teer, upar e⁻ acceptor tak gulabi teer, Electron transport system, wapas P 700 tak teer, ADP + Pi → ATP; relay mein khiladi track ka chakkar lagakar lautta (apni tasveer); aakhir mein dikhe ki PS II aur NADP⁺ ka raasta nahi hai.

terms.meaning: gol chakkar wala

says: Toh shuruaat ka sawaal: jab NADP⁺ tak jaane ka raasta na ho, toh electron kahan jaata hai?
Jab NADP⁺ tak raasta na ho, toh electron carriers ki kadi se hokar wapas PS I par laut aata hai.
Aisa tab hota hai jab sirf PS I kaam kar raha ho. Electron PS I ke andar hi chakkar lagata rehta hai.
Is gol bahav ke saath jo phosphorylation hoti hai, wahi cyclic photo-phosphorylation hai.
Par chloroplast mein aisa kahan ho sakta hai, yeh samajhne ke liye pehle uske andar ka naksha yaad karo.
Chloroplast mein thylakoid ki chapti thailiyan sikkon ki tarah ek ke upar ek rakhi hoti hain. Inke dher grana kehlate hain.
Do dheron ko jodne wali patli, bina dher wali membrane bhi hoti hai, jaise do imaraton ke beech ka galiyara. Inhe hum pehle stroma lamellae ke naam se dekh chuke hain; lamella yaani patli parat.
Grana ki membrane mein dono photosystem hote hain, PS I bhi aur PS II bhi.
Par stroma lamellae ki membrane mein PS II nahi hota. Aur NADP reductase enzyme bhi nahi hota.
NADP reductase woh enzyme hai jo NADP⁺ se NADPH banne ka kaam karata hai. Reductase yaani reduction karaane wala.
Toh socho, stroma lamellae mein uchhle electron ko NADP⁺ tak pahunchane wala enzyme hi nahi hai. Isliye electron ke paas wapas lautne ke siva koi raasta nahi.
Isliye stroma lamellae ko cyclic photo-phosphorylation ki ek sambhav jagah maana jaata hai.
Nateeja pakka yaad rakho: gol raaste mein sirf ATP banta hai, NADPH + H⁺ nahi banta.

Aksar log sochte hain ki light reaction mein hamesha ATP, NADPH aur O₂ teeno banenge. Par aisa nahi hai: gol raaste mein electron NADP⁺ tak jaata hi nahi, aur PS II ke bina paani bhi nahi tootta, isliye sirf ATP banta hai.
Ek aur haalat hai. Yaad karo, roshni lehron mein chalti hai, aur ek lehar ki chot se agli chot tak ki doori wavelength hai.
PS II ka centre P680 hai, jo lagbhag 680 nm ki roshni chahta hai. PS I ka P700, 700 nm tak ki roshni bhi pakad leta hai.
Jab sirf 680 nm se aage ki roshni mile, toh PS II theek se nahi jaagta. Sirf PS I chalta hai, aur cyclic photo-phosphorylation hoti hai.
Aksar log ise ulta samajh lete hain, par 680 nm se aage ka matlab hai 680 se zyada, yaani lambi wavelength, kam wavelength nahi.
Paudhe ko yeh gol raasta kyon chahiye, iska ek bada kaaran hum aage Calvin cycle mein dekhenge. Abhi bas itna jaan lo ki kabhi paudhe ko NADPH se zyada ATP chahiye hota hai.
points.screen: Electron wapas PS I par; chloroplast ka naksha: grana sikkon ke dher jaise, unhe jodti stroma lamellae galiyare jaisi; grana ki membrane mein PS I aur PS II, stroma lamellae mein sirf PS I (PS II aur NADP reductase nahi); lautta electron; sirf ATP; 680 nm aur 700 nm ki lehrein, 680 se lambi lehar.

terms.meaning: reduction karaane wala enzyme jo NADP⁺ se NADPH banwata hai

says: Ab ek electron ko pakad kar stroma lamellae mein uska poora safar chalate hain.
Roshni P 700 par padi, aur uska ek electron energy lekar uchhal gaya.
e⁻ acceptor ne use pakda, aur woh carriers ki kadi mein aage badha.
Kadi ke aage use NADP⁺ tak le jaane wala NADP reductase mila hi nahi, kyunki yahan woh enzyme hai hi nahi.
Toh electron kadi se ghoom kar wapas P 700 par aa gaya, aur agli roshni ka intezaar karne laga.
Is ek chakkar ke saath ATP bana. NADPH ek bhi nahi bana, aur O₂ bhi nahi nikli.
points.screen: Stroma lamellae mein ek electron ka safar, kadam-kadam ek hi tasveer par: P 700 par roshni, electron uchhla, e⁻ acceptor, kadi, NADP reductase ki khaali jagah, wapas P 700; ATP bana, NADPH aur O₂ nahi.

says: Ruko, pehle khud socho: agar kisi patti par sirf 700 nm wali roshni pade, toh usme NADPH banega ya nahi?
Aapne socha hoga ki NADPH nahi banega, aur yahi sahi hai. Aisi roshni mein sirf PS I chalega, electron gol chakkar lagayega, aur sirf ATP banega.
Ab dono raaste ek saath rakh kar dekho.
Seedhe raaste, yaani non-cyclic, mein electron paani se chalta hai: pehle PS II, phir PS I, aur aakhir NADP⁺. ATP, NADPH aur O₂ teeno bante hain.
Gol raaste, yaani cyclic, mein sirf PS I kaam karta hai, aur electron wapas P 700 par aata hai. Sirf ATP banta hai; na NADPH, na O₂.
Ab shuruaat ka sawaal phir se: NADP⁺ ka raasta band ho, toh electron kahan jaayega, aur kya kuch banega?
Raasta band ho, toh electron carriers ki kadi se ghoom kar wapas P 700 par aa jaata hai.
Aur tab bhi kuch banta hai: ATP, bas NADPH nahi.
Ab ek ajeeb baat par gaur karo, jo hamari agli film ka sawaal hai: dono raaston mein ATP bana, par electron ne kahin bhi ADP ko chhua tak nahi.
Toh ATP bana kaise?
ATP bana kaise, yeh aage hum dekhenge.
points.screen: Sawaal screen par; dono raaste saath-saath: non-cyclic (paani, PS II, PS I, NADP⁺; ATP, NADPH, O₂) aur cyclic (PS I se wapas P 700; sirf ATP); shuruaat ka sawaal phir screen par, NADP⁺ ka band raasta; electron kadi se ghoom kar wapas P 700, ATP bana, NADPH nahi; aakhir mein electron aur ADP ke beech khaali jagah, sawaal khula.
points.answer: Sirf 700 nm ki roshni mein sirf PS I chalega, electron gol chakkar lagayega, sirf ATP banega, NADPH nahi.

facts.fact: Thylakoid membrane ke andar lumen aur bahar stroma hai; H⁺ positive hydrogen ion hai.
ADP aur inorganic phosphate ko jodkar ATP banane ke liye energy chahiye.
Photosynthesis aur respiration mein ATP synthesis membrane ke across proton gradient se judi hai.
H⁺ ka membrane ke dono taraf fark aur unka lautna ATP synthesis kaise chalaate hain, iska explanation.
Membrane ke dono taraf H⁺ ki concentration aur electrical haalat mein fark.
Chloroplast mein H⁺ thylakoid lumen mein jama hote hain.
Mitochondrion ki outer aur inner membrane alag boundaries hain.
Mitochondrion ki outer aur inner membrane ke beech ki jagah.
Respiration mein ETS ke electron movement ke saath protons mitochondrial intermembrane space mein jama hote hain, matrix mein nahi.
Light ki energy milne se electrons ka excited hona.
Gradient ke causes samajhne ke liye electron activation aur transport ke steps dobara dekhne hain.

points.watch_out: ATP aur NADPH ko long-term stored reserves ya bakery ingredients ke chemically identical equivalents na samjhein.

says: Socho, phir aage badhenge: kya biosynthetic phase ko dark reaction kehna misleading naam, ya misnomer, ho sakta hai?
Light-off timeline ko reason banao; kya darkness ne synthesis ko start kiya tha?
Dekho, darkness is phase ki requirement nahi hai, aur light-reaction supplies khatam hone par yeh rukta hai, isliye dark naam night-only process ka galat impression deta hai.
Aksar log sochte hain ki light reactions din mein aur dark reactions sirf raat mein chalti hain, par asal mein yeh directly aur indirectly light-dependent kaamon ka distinction hai.
points.screen: Light-off timeline par brief continuation aur later stop highlighted; uske saamne label: directly light-driven nahi, light-reaction products par dependent.
points.answer: Dark naam misleading hai kyunki darkness required nahi; ATP aur NADPH ki renewed supply ke liye biosynthesis indirectly light reactions par depend karti hai.
points.watch_out: Brief continuation ko unlimited darkness mein synthesis ka proof na samjhein; remaining supplies limited hain.

says: Ab ATP aur NADPH ka detailed use samajhne ke liye overall sugar formation ke andar carbon ka raasta dhoondhenge.
Humne CO₂ aur H₂O se carbohydrate formation ka overall account dekha tha; ab wahi carbohydrate composition (CH₂O)ₙ se likh sakte hain.
Is notation mein n batata hai ki CH₂O ka composition ratio kitni baar liya gaya; glucose ke liye n six hai.
Kya overall equation bata deti hai ki incoming carbon sabse pehle kis compound mein gaya?
Dekho, overall equation manzil batati hai, isliye scientists ne first product, yaani CO₂ fix hone ke baad sabse pehle pehchaane jaane wale compound, ki khoj ki.
Fixation ka pehle khola meaning yaad rakho: CO₂ ke carbon ko organic molecule ka hissa banana.
points.screen: Stroma mein CO₂ + H₂O se (CH₂O)ₙ ki overall arrow; arrow ke beech pehla unknown product-box khulta hai. Side par (CH₂O)₆ → C₆H₁₂O₆.

terms.meaning: Carbohydrate composition ka general notation; n CH₂O ratio ki repetitions batata hai.
CO₂ fixation ke baad shuru mein pehchaana gaya reaction product.

says: Calvin aur Bassham ki labelled carbon wali khoj hum pehle mil chuke hain; ab us investigation ka specific result dekho.
World War II ke baad radioactive isotopes, ya radioisotopes, ka beneficial use karte hue Calvin ne algae mein photosynthesis investigate ki.
Pehle khola radioactive ¹⁴C yahaan carbon ki pehchaan tha; early products mein uska signal incoming carbon ka destination batata tha.
Un studies mein pehla identified CO₂ fixation product three-carbon organic acid, 3-phosphoglyceric acid, mila; iska short name PGA hai.
Final sugar se pehle acid milna important kyun tha?
Dekho, isse pata chala ki fixed carbon seedha final glucose ke roop mein identify nahi hua, balki beech ke product PGA mein mila.
Calvin aur co-workers ne complete biosynthetic pathway bhi work out kiya; unke naam par ise Calvin cycle kaha gaya.
points.screen: Algal culture ko ¹⁴CO₂ input; early separated product mein labelled PGA highlighted. PGA ke teen carbon positions aur neeche pathway name Calvin cycle; abhi detailed cycle steps nahi.

terms.meaning: Elements ke radioactive isotopes, jinhe detectable tracing labels ki tarah use kar sakte hain.
Carbon ka radioactive isotope jiska mass number 14 hai; pehle C¹⁴ notation mein pehchaana tha.
3-phosphoglyceric acid; teen carbon wala organic acid aur identified early fixation product.
Calvin ke naam par jaana jaane wala photosynthetic carbon-assimilation ka biosynthetic pathway.

says: Ab batao, PGA ke ek molecule mein kitne carbon atoms hain?
Dekho, PGA mein teen carbon atoms hain; tracer ka 14 carbon isotope ka mass number hai, PGA ke carbon atoms ki count nahi.
Ek PGA molecule mein labelled carbon milne se uska poora skeleton fourteen-carbon wala nahi ban jaata.
points.screen: Ek PGA carbon skeleton par teen numbered carbon positions; ek position par ¹⁴C tag. Separate labels: molecule carbon count = 3; tracer mass number = 14.
points.outside_book: Tracer mass number aur product carbon-count ka explicit distinction added hai.
points.answer: PGA ke ek molecule mein teen carbon atoms hote hain.
points.watch_out: ¹⁴C ka 14 isotope mass number hai, molecule mein carbon atoms ki sankhya nahi.

says: Agla sawaal tha: kya har plant mein initial CO₂ fixation ka pehla stable product PGA hi hota hai?
Wide plant surveys mein doosra group mila, jiska first stable product four-carbon organic acid oxaloacetic acid tha.
First stable product fixation ke baad pehla stable compound hai, sirf overall final sugar nahi.
CO₂ fixation ka meaning wahi organic molecule mein carbon jodna hai; CO₂ assimilation ka broader meaning us carbon ko plant ke organic substances mein incorporate karna hai.
Jin plants ka initial stable product three-carbon PGA hai, unka initial route C₃ pathway kehlaata hai.
Jinmein four-carbon oxaloacetic acid pehla stable product hai, unka initial route C₄ pathway kehlaata hai.
In names ke three aur four kya ginte hain?
Dekho, yeh first stable product ke carbon atoms ginte hain, incoming CO₂ molecules ya carbon lene wale starting molecule ke carbons nahi; associated differences aage dekhenge.
points.screen: Survey ka simple two-branch comparison: C₃ → PGA → 3 carbon positions; C₄ → oxaloacetic acid → 4 carbon positions. Column heading: initial first stable fixation product.

terms.meaning: CO₂ ke carbon ko organic molecule mein jodna; pehle fixing CO₂ ke roop mein samjha tha.
CO₂ ke carbon ko plant ke organic substances ka hissa banana.
Four-carbon organic acid; C₄ route ka initial first stable fixation product.
Initial fixation ke baad milne wala pehla stable compound.

points.watch_out: First stable product ko carbon receive karne wale starting molecule se confuse na karein.

says: Ab poora connection jodo: light reactions ki O₂ bahar diffuse hoti hai, aur ATP tatha NADPH stromal sugar synthesis ko support karte hain.
Light band hone par remaining supplies se brief continuation milti hai, phir stop; light lautne par renewed supply se synthesis resume hoti hai.
Carbon ka raasta dhoondhne par algal tracer studies mein three-carbon PGA pehla identified product mila.
Wider surveys ne four-carbon oxaloacetic acid wala initial route bhi dikhaya, isliye first stable product se C₃ aur C₄ classification bani.
Lekin incoming CO₂ ko sabse pehle receive kaun karta hai?
Dekho, product ki identity mil gayi hai; use banane wale primary CO₂ acceptor ki identity agle heading mein dekhenge.
points.screen: Teen connected compact panels: light supplies → stromal synthesis; on/off/on response; PGA–3C versus oxaloacetic acid–4C. Last panel se agle sawaal ki taraf arrow: CO₂ ko receive kaun karta hai?

parts.bridge: Pehla product PGA pehchaan liya; ab primary CO₂ acceptor khojkar samjhenge ki incoming carbon us product tak kaise pahunchta hai.
parts.title: WHERE ARE THE ATP AND NADPH USED?

parts.goal: Ab PGA ki pehchaan se aage badhkar CO₂ lene wala starting molecule khojenge, aur uske carbon count ko product ke carbon count se jodenge.

says: Ab PGA ki pehchaan se aage badhkar CO₂ lene wala starting molecule khojenge, aur uske carbon count ko product ke carbon count se jodenge.
Yahaan incoming CO₂ jis starting molecule se judta hai, use khojna hai; electron receive karne wala primary acceptor isse alag hai.
PGA mein teen carbon atoms hain, jaisa hum abhi pehchaan chuke hain.
Scientists ka sawaal bhi yahi tha: ek-carbon CO₂ judne ke baad three-carbon PGA mile, toh starting molecule mein kitne carbons honge?
Teen mein se ek ghataakar two-carbon starting molecule sochna natural hai, lekin kya product ke sirf ek molecule ko ginana kaafi hai?
Dekho, starting molecule ka carbon count nikaalne ke liye product molecules ki total count bhi chahiye, isliye sirf subtraction se identity decide nahi hogi.
points.screen: Chloroplast ke stromal region par CO₂ ka one-carbon model aur ek three-carbon PGA model; starting molecule ki jagah question mark, saath product molecules ki count ke liye khaali boxes.
points.answer: Ek PGA ke three carbons se starting molecule ka size decide nahi hota; total product molecules bhi ginne honge.
points.watch_out: 3 − 1 = 2 tabhi valid inference hota jab ek starting molecule aur ek CO₂ se sirf ek PGA banta.

says: Experiments ka unexpected answer five-carbon ketose sugar ribulose bisphosphate, ya RuBP, tha.
Incoming CO₂ isi starting sugar molecule se judta hai.
RuBP mein five-carbon skeleton aur do alag positions par phosphate groups hote hain; bisphosphate naam in do phosphate groups ko batata hai.
Ketose sugar ka matlab aisa sugar hai jiski open-chain form mein ketone group hota hai.
Ketone group mein ek carbon oxygen se double bond banata hai aur dono taraf carbon se juda hota hai.
Five-carbon starting molecule se three-carbon product kaise milega?
Dekho, carbon conservation sahi rehti hai; humein reaction ke saare product molecules ka hisaab jodna hoga.
points.screen: Usi stromal picture mein RuBP ka five-carbon molecular model; terminal positions par do phosphate tags aur open-chain structure mein internal C=O highlight.

terms.meaning: Five-carbon sugar jiske do alag positions par phosphate groups lage hote hain; incoming CO₂ isse judta hai.
Sugar jiski open-chain form mein ketone group hota hai.

points.outside_book: Ketone group ki basic bonding aur bisphosphate naam ke parts ki explanation clarity ke liye jodi gayi hai.

says: Agar tumne two-carbon acceptor guess kiya, toh ghabraao mat; scientists ne bhi pehle yahi possibility sochi thi.
Unhone many years ek 2-carbon compound, yaani do carbon atoms wale compound, ko acceptor ke roop mein dhoondhne mein lagaaye.
Bahut experiments ke baad five-carbon RuBP ki identity mili.
Galat guess itna convincing kyun laga?
Aksar log sochte hain ki three-carbon PGA milne par starting acceptor two-carbon hi hoga, par asal mein ek product molecule ka size poore reaction ka carbon total nahi hota.
Dekho, saare product molecules ginne par five-carbon RuBP ka hisaab milta hai.
points.screen: Research timeline: three-carbon PGA se two-carbon acceptor ka initial hypothesis; multiple experimental observations ke baad five-carbon RuBP ki confirmed identity.

terms.meaning: Aisa compound jiske ek molecule mein do carbon atoms hon.

says: Ab ek RuBP molecule ke five carbon counters lo, aur incoming CO₂ ka ek carbon counter unke saath jodo.
Balanced equations mein atoms conserve hote hain, jaisa hum overall photosynthesis equation mein dekh chuke hain.
Total six carbons ko do three-carbon groups mein baanto; har group ek PGA molecule ka carbon skeleton dikhata hai.
Carbon ledger hua: 5 + 1 = 3 + 3.
Kya six-carbon total ka matlab ek stable six-carbon product hi milega?
Dekho, total carbon count six hai, lekin stable products do PGA molecules hain; ek molecule ka size aur saare products ka total alag quantities hain.
points.screen: Pehle wale RuBP model ke five carbon counters mein ek labelled CO₂ carbon judta hai; wahi six counters do PGA groups mein bantte hain, neeche 5 + 1 = 3 + 3.
points.outside_book: Do PGA molecules ka carbon ledger agle heading ki reaction ko samajhne ke liye yahaan briefly khola gaya hai.

says: Socho, packing table par five toy blocks pehle se rakhe hain aur courier ek aur block laata hai.
Worker six blocks ko do parcels mein pack karta hai, har parcel mein three blocks.
Tum sirf ek parcel kholkar bolo ki three blocks mein se one naya tha, isliye table par pehle sirf two blocks honge.
Yeh conclusion kyun galat hoga?
Dekho, doosre parcel ke three blocks bhi same starting collection se aaye hain, isliye poori shipment ginne par starting five blocks ka hisaab milta hai.
Yahaan starting five blocks RuBP ke carbons hain, naya block CO₂ ka carbon hai, aur two parcels do PGA molecules hain.
points.screen: Packing table ke five toy blocks, ek arriving block, phir do three-block parcels; unke neeche corresponding RuBP, CO₂ aur two PGA carbon groups.
points.outside_book: Parcel analogy carbon conservation aur product count ka distinction samjhaati hai.
points.answer: Five starting blocks = RuBP ke five carbons; incoming block = CO₂ ka carbon; two three-block parcels = do PGA molecules.
points.watch_out: Toy blocks unchanged objects hain; actual reaction mein atoms ke chemical bonds rearrange hote hain.

says: Socho, phir aage badhenge: two RuBP molecules two CO₂ molecules accept karein, toh kitne PGA molecules ke liye carbon available hoga?
Pehle starting aur incoming carbons ka total nikaalo, phir three-carbon groups gino.
Dekho, two RuBP ke ten carbons aur two CO₂ ke two carbons milkar twelve hote hain, isliye four three-carbon PGA molecules ka carbon account banta hai.
Isse acceptor aur first stable product ka farq clear rakho: acceptor RuBP five-carbon hai, jabki product PGA three-carbon hai.
points.screen: Do RuBP carbon groups, do incoming CO₂ carbons, aur learner ke liye khaali PGA boxes; phir twelve counters four three-carbon groups mein.
points.answer: 2 × 5 + 2 × 1 = 12 carbons; 12 ÷ 3 = 4 PGA molecules.
points.watch_out: Two CO₂ se sirf two PGA ginne par six carbons missing ho jaate hain; har RuBP acceptance se do PGA ka account banta hai.

parts.bridge: Ab acceptor aur products ka carbon hisaab mil gaya; Calvin cycle mein dekhenge ki reaction kaise chalti hai aur RuBP dobara kaise taiyaar hota hai.
parts.title: The Primary Acceptor of CO₂

parts.goal: Har CO₂ ko pakadne mein ek RuBP kharch ho jaata hai; toh patti din bhar CO₂ kaise pakadti rehti hai, uska RuBP khatam kyun nahi hota?
parts.misaal: dukaan ki poonji: RuBP poonji ki thaili (paanch carbon = paanch rupaye), har CO₂ ka carbon ek naya rupaya, triose phosphate teen rupaye ka hissa, ATP aur NADPH bijli-mazdoori ka kharcha, bahar nikli sugar kamaai

facts.fact: Calvin aur unke saathiyon ne poora raasta khoja aur dikhaya ki yeh raasta cycle ki tarah, yaani gol chakkar mein, chalta hai, aur RuBP dobara banta hai (regenerated).
Regenerated: use hone ke baad phir se banaya gaya; re = phir se, generate = banana.
RuBP paanch carbon wala sugar hai jo CO₂ ko pakadta hai, yaani CO₂ acceptor; CO₂ mein ek hi carbon atom hai; RuBP + CO₂ se teen-teen carbon ke do PGA bante hain (5 + 1 = 3 + 3).
Cycle: aisa raasta jo ghoom kar apne starting component par return karta hai; ek chakkar ke baad shuruaat wali cheez wapas mil jaati hai.
Melvin Calvin ko paudhon mein CO₂ assimilation ki is khoj ke liye 1961 mein Chemistry ka Nobel puraskaar mila.
Ab dekhna hai ki Calvin pathway kaise chalta hai aur sugar kahan banti hai; Calvin pathway sabhi photosynthetic paudhon mein hota hai, chahe unka raasta C₃ ho, C₄ ho ya koi aur.
Calvin pathway: Calvin cycle ka hi naam; pathway = raasta, Calvin ka khoja hua raasta.
C₃ aur C₄ classification pehle stable product ke carbon ginkar: C₃ mein PGA (teen carbon), C₄ mein oxaloacetic acid (chaar carbon).
Stroma: chloroplast mein thylakoid ki thailiyon ke chaaron taraf ka gaadha ras; thylakoid mein bane ATP aur NADPH yahin aate hain, aur sugar banane wale enzymes yahin hain.
C₄ paudhe CO₂ ko pehle ek alag tareeke se pakadte hain par aakhir mein Calvin cycle ko hi dete hain; CO₂ se sugar banane ka kaam sirf Calvin cycle karta hai.
Samajhne mein aasaani ke liye Calvin cycle ko teen stages mein baanta jaata hai: carboxylation, reduction aur regeneration.
Kadam 1, carboxylation: CO₂ ko ek stable organic intermediate mein fix karna; yeh Calvin cycle ka sabse crucial kadam hai, jahan CO₂ se RuBP ka carboxylation hota hai.
Yeh reaction enzyme RuBP carboxylase catalyse karta hai, aur isse 3-PGA ke do molecule bante hain.
Is enzyme mein oxygenation activity bhi hai, isliye ise RuBP carboxylase-oxygenase ya RuBisCO kehna zyada sahi hai.
Carboxylation: molecule par carboxyl group (COOH) jodna, jo CO₂ se banta hai; yahan RuBP par CO₂ judna.
Stable organic intermediate: stable = tikau, turant na tootne wala; organic = carbon wala molecule; intermediate = beech ka padaav, aakhri product nahi.
3-PGA = 3-phosphoglyceric acid: teen carbon ka glyceric acid, jiske teesre carbon par phosphate laga hai; COOH group ise acid banata hai.
Catalysed: enzyme ne reaction tez karaya, aur khud badla nahi.
Oxygenation activity: CO₂ ki jagah O₂ ko RuBP par jodne ki kaabiliyat.
RuBP carboxylase-oxygenase (RuBisCO): RuBP par carboxylation bhi aur oxygenation bhi karne wala enzyme; -ase = enzyme.
RuBP aur CO₂ pehle chhe carbon ka ek molecule banate hain jo turant do 3-PGA mein toot jaata hai; isliye pehla stable molecule 3-PGA hai.
RuBisCO dharti par sabse zyada paya jaane wala protein hai.
Enzyme: protein jo reaction tez karta hai aur khud nahi badalta; naam aksar -ase par khatam hota hai.
Kadam 2, reduction: reactions ki series jo glucose banne ki taraf le jaati hai; per CO₂ molecule fixed 2 ATP phosphorylation ke liye aur 2 NADPH reduction ke liye lagte hain.
Six CO₂ ka fixation aur cycle ke 6 turns se ek glucose molecule banta hai.
Per CO₂ molecule fixed: har ek pakde gaye CO₂ ke hisaab se.
Turn: cycle ka ek poora ghumaav, jisme ek CO₂ fix hota hai; turns = aise kai ghumaav.
Phosphorylation = phosphate jodna (ATP apna phosphate deta hai); reduction = electron aur hydrogen milna (NADPH deta hai).
Reduction mein 3-PGA (acid) ATP se phosphate aur NADPH se electron lekar triose phosphate (teen carbon ki sugar) banta hai; tri = teen, ose = sugar.
Glucose mein chhe carbon hote hain; CO₂ mein ek.
Kadam 3, regeneration: CO₂ acceptor RuBP ka dobara banna crucial hai taaki cycle uninterrupted chale; RuBP banane ki phosphorylation mein ek ATP lagta hai.
CO₂ acceptor: CO₂ ko lene wala molecule (accept = lena), yahan RuBP; light reaction ke electron lene wale primary acceptor se alag.
Uninterrupted: bina ruke, lagaataar.
Paanch triose phosphate (15 carbon) jod-tod se teen RuBP (15 carbon) bante hain; RuBP ka doosra phosphate ATP jodta hai, isliye RuBP mein do phosphate (bis).
Teen CO₂ par: 3 RuBP (15 C) + 3 CO₂ (3 C) = 18 C, phir 6 3-PGA, phir 6 triose phosphate; 5 wapas (15 C se 3 RuBP), 1 bahar (3 C); chhe CO₂ par 2 bahar = 6 C = ek glucose.
Har CO₂ jo Calvin cycle mein aata hai, uske liye 3 ATP aur 2 NADPH lagte hain.
ATP aur NADPH ki sankhya ka yeh farq poora karne ke liye shayad cyclic phosphorylation hota hai.
Cyclic phosphorylation: cyclic photophosphorylation, jisme electron PS I se ghoom kar wahin lautta hai aur sirf ATP banta hai, NADPH nahi.
Non-cyclic raasta ATP aur NADPH dono banata hai; cyclic sirf ATP.
Ek glucose molecule banane ke liye cycle ke 6 turns chahiye.
Ek glucose ke liye kitne ATP aur NADPH lagenge, yeh khud nikaalna hai: chhe turns × 3 ATP = 18 ATP, chhe × 2 NADPH = 12 NADPH.
Calvin cycle mein kya andar jaata hai aur kya bahar aata hai, yeh dekhna madad karta hai: In: six CO₂, 18 ATP, 12 NADPH; Out: one glucose, 18 ADP, 12 NADP.

Figure 11.8: Calvin cycle teen stages mein: (1) carboxylation, CO₂ ribulose-1,5-bisphosphate se judta hai; (2) reduction, photochemically made ATP aur NADPH ke kharche par carbohydrate banta hai; (3) regeneration, CO₂ acceptor ribulose-1,5-bisphosphate phir banta hai taaki cycle chalta rahe.
Photochemically made: roshni se chalne wali reactions mein bana; photo = roshni, chemical = rasayanik.
Upar Atmosphere: CO₂ hawa se aata hai.
Andar aate teer par CO₂ + H₂O, jo carboxylation mein jaate hain.
RuBP ka poora naam; pehle aur paanchve carbon par phosphate, bis = do.
1 Carboxylation ka dabba, pehla stage.
Carboxylation ke baad bana compound; 3-PGA ka doosra naam.
2 Reduction ka dabba, doosra stage.
Reduction mein andar aate hain.
Reduction se bahar jaate hain: kharch hue ATP aur NADPH ke bache roop.
Reduction ke baad bana; yahan se raasta do mein bantta hai.
Triose phosphate se neeche ka teer: sucrose aur starch.
3 Regeneration ka dabba; ATP andar, ADP bahar, aur raasta wapas RuBP par.
Sucrose ganne aur cheeni wali sugar hai jo paudhe mein ek jagah se doosri jagah jaati hai; starch jama ki gayi sugar hai, jaise aaloo, chawal, gehun mein.
Carboxylation mein ATP ya NADPH nahi lagta; RuBP mein regeneration wale ATP ki energy pehle se hoti hai, isliye CO₂ ka judna apne aap aage badhne wali reaction hai.

says: Pichhli baar humne woh molecule pehchaana jo CO₂ ko pakadta hai: paanch carbon wala sugar, RuBP.
RuBP ke paanch carbon mein CO₂ ka ek carbon juda, kul chhe hue. Inse teen-teen carbon ke do PGA bane.
Yaad rakhein: CO₂ pakadte hi woh RuBP, RuBP nahi rehta; woh toot kar PGA ban jaata hai.
Aage hum dekhenge ki yahi ek baat ek badi paheli khadi kar deti hai.
Ab socho: har CO₂ ko pakadne mein ek RuBP kharch ho jaata hai. Aur patti din bhar laakhon CO₂ pakadti rehti hai.
Toh patti CO₂ kaise pakadti rehti hai, uska RuBP khatam kyun nahi hota?
RuBP khatam kyun nahi hota, isi sawaal ka jawab Melvin Calvin aur unke saathiyon ne dhoondha.
Yeh wahi Calvin hain jinke radioactive carbon wale prayog se humne pehla product PGA pehchaana tha.
Ab unhone kadam-dar-kadam poora raasta khoj nikala.
Is kaam ke liye Calvin ko 1961 mein chemistry ka Nobel puraskaar mila.
Dekho, unhone dikhaya ki yeh raasta seedhi line nahi, ek gol chakkar hai: jahan se shuru hota hai, ghoom kar wahin lautta hai.
Isliye ise cycle kehte hain: chakkar ki shuruaat mein RuBP hai, aur chakkar ke aakhir mein RuBP phir se ban jaata hai.
Use hone ke baad phir se banna, isi ko regenerated hona kehte hain: re yaani phir se, generate yaani banana.
Toh RuBP kharch to hota hai, par chakkar use dobara bana deta hai. Isliye woh kabhi khatam nahi hota.
Bilkul ek achhi dukaan ki tarah: dukaandar roz apni poonji lagata hai, par shaam ko poonji wapas thaili mein rakh leta hai.
Ghar sirf uski kamaai jaati hai.
Poonji roz lagti hai, phir bhi khatam nahi hoti, kyunki kamaai mein se hi wapas bhar jaati hai.
Toh samjho, is chakkar mein RuBP wahi poonji hai, aur jo sugar bahar nikalti hai, woh kamaai.
Par RuBP dobara banta kis cheez se hai, aur is kaam mein kharcha kitna lagta hai?
RuBP dobara kaise banta hai aur kharcha kitna lagta hai, yeh hum chakkar ke kadam khol kar dekhenge.
points.screen: Pichhla milan: paanch moti ki RuBP maala mein ek CO₂ moti judta hai, chhe moti teen-teen ke do PGA mein bantte hain, aur RuBP ki maala wahan nahi bachti; neeche 'Yaad rakhein: CO₂ pakadte hi RuBP toot kar PGA'. Phir ek hari patti par din bhar aate CO₂ ke teer, aur sawaal 'RuBP khatam kyun nahi hota?'. Melvin Calvin ka naam aur '1961 Nobel'. Ek gol chakkar ka teer jo RuBP se chalkar wapas RuBP par lautta hai, us par 'regenerated'. Phir dukaan: dukaandar ki thaili se poonji nikalti, shaam ko wapas thaili mein, aur alag se 'kamaai' ghar jaati; neeche jod: RuBP = poonji, sugar = kamaai.

terms.meaning: Use hone ke baad phir se banaya gaya; re = phir se, generate = banana.

points.outside_book: Melvin Calvin ko 1961 mein chemistry ka Nobel puraskaar (paudhon mein CO₂ assimilation ki khoj); dukaan ki poonji ki misaal.
points.watch_out: Dukaan ki poonji sirf picture hai: RuBP ke carbon sikkon ki tarah jyon ke tyon nahi lautte; woh nayi molecules mein jod-tod hokar RuBP banate hain.

says: Yeh chakkar chalta kahan hai?
Yeh chakkar chalta hai chloroplast ke stroma mein, yaani thylakoid ki thailiyon ke chaaron taraf bhare gaadhe ras mein.
Yaad karo, thylakoid mein roshni se ATP aur NADPH bante hain, aur dono stroma mein hi chhode jaate hain.
Isliye sugar bhi yahin stroma mein banti hai: CO₂, ATP aur NADPH, teeno ek hi jagah milte hain.
Ab C₃ aur C₄ ko yaad karo: yeh naam pehle stable product ke carbon ginkar diye gaye the.
C₃ paudhon mein pehla product teen carbon wala PGA hai, aur C₄ paudhon mein chaar carbon wala oxaloacetic acid.
Aksar log sochte hain ki Calvin cycle sirf C₃ paudhon mein chalta hai, kyunki PGA wahi banate hain. Par aisa nahi hai.
Dekho, har photosynthesis karne wale paudhe mein yeh chakkar chalta hai, chahe woh C₃ ho, C₄ ho, ya koi aur raasta rakhta ho.
Kyun? Kyunki CO₂ ke carbon se sugar banane ka kaam sirf yahi chakkar karta hai.
C₄ paudhe CO₂ ko pehle ek alag tareeke se pakadte hain. Par aakhir mein use isi chakkar ko saunp dete hain; yeh hum aage C₄ wale hisse mein dekhenge.
Isliye is raaste ko Calvin pathway bhi kehte hain: pathway yaani raasta, Calvin ka khoja hua raasta.
Ab yeh chakkar ek saath kai kaam karta hai, isliye samajhne mein aasaani ke liye ise teen kadamon mein baanta jaata hai.
Yaad rakho: pehla kadam carboxylation hai, doosra reduction, aur teesra regeneration.
Seedhe shabdon mein: pehle kadam mein CO₂ andar aata hai, doosre mein usse sugar banti hai, aur teesre mein RuBP phir banta hai.
Dukaan ki zubaan mein: pehle naya paisa aata hai, phir kharcha karke maal taiyaar hota hai. Aakhir mein poonji wapas thaili mein jaati hai.
points.screen: Chloroplast ka cutaway: hari thylakoid thailiyon ke dher, unke chaaron taraf stroma ka gaadha ras roshan; thylakoid se ATP aur NADPH ke chhote moti stroma mein aate, saath bahar se CO₂ andar aata. Phir do paudhe: C₃ (PGA, teen moti) aur C₄ (oxaloacetic acid, chaar moti); 'sirf C₃ mein?' par kaata hua nishaan, aur dono paudhon se teer ek hi gol chakkar 'Calvin pathway' tak. Phir gol chakkar teen hisson mein: 1 carboxylation (CO₂ andar), 2 reduction (sugar banti), 3 regeneration (RuBP wapas); kone mein dukaan ke teen chhote chitra: naya paisa, maal taiyaar, poonji thaili mein.

terms.meaning: Calvin cycle ka hi doosra naam; pathway = raasta, Calvin ka khoja hua raasta, jo har photosynthetic paudhe mein chalta hai.

points.outside_book: C₄ paudhe CO₂ ko pehle alag tareeke se pakad kar aakhir mein Calvin cycle ko hi dete hain (aage 11.8).

says: Pehla kadam wahi milan hai jo humne pichhli baar gina tha: RuBP aur CO₂ ka judna.
CO₂ ek gas hai jo hawa mein udti phirti hai. Is kadam mein uska carbon ek molecule mein pakka bandh jaata hai.
Gas ke carbon ko aise pakka baandh dena hi CO₂ fixation hai, jise hum pehle mil chuke hain.
Ab is kadam ka naam samjho: carboxyl ek chhota group hai, COOH, jo CO₂ se banta hai.
Molecule par CO₂ jodkar yeh carboxyl group banana, isi ko carboxylation kehte hain.
Toh carboxylation mein CO₂ ka carbon ek stable organic intermediate mein fix ho jaata hai.
Stable yaani tikau, jo turant na toote; organic yaani carbon wala; intermediate yaani beech ka padaav, aakhri manzil nahi.
Ise tikau kyun kaha? Ise tikau isliye kaha, kyunki RuBP aur CO₂ milkar pehle chhe carbon ka ek molecule banate hain.
Woh molecule pal bhar bhi nahi tikta, aur turant teen-teen carbon ke do hisson mein toot jaata hai.
Yahi tikau hissa 3-PGA hai, aur ek RuBP aur ek CO₂ se iske do molecule bante hain.
Ab 3-PGA ka naam todo: poora naam 3-phosphoglyceric acid hai, aur glyceric acid teen carbon ka ek acid hai.
Phospho yaani us par ek phosphate laga hai, aur shuru ka 3 batata hai ki phosphate teesre carbon par baitha hai.
Aur ise acid isliye kehte hain, kyunki CO₂ se aaya COOH group hi ise acid banata hai.
Yeh poore chakkar ka sabse zaroori, yaani most crucial, kadam hai. Kyunki yahin hawa ka carbon pehli baar jeevit duniya mein aata hai.
Par yeh milan apne aap bahut dheere hota hai, isliye ek enzyme ise tez karta hai.
Enzyme ek protein hai jo reaction ko tez karata hai aur khud nahi badalta; aise naam aksar -ase par khatam hote hain.
Enzyme ke is tez karaane ko kehte hain ki reaction catalysed hua; yahan reaction RuBP carboxylase se catalysed hota hai.
Naam hi kaam batata hai: RuBP par carboxylation karne wala, aur aakhir ka -ase yaani enzyme.
Par iska poora naam isse bhi lamba hai; aisa kyun?
Poora naam isliye lamba hai, kyunki yahi enzyme RuBP par CO₂ ki jagah O₂ bhi jod sakta hai.
O₂ jodne ki is kaabiliyat ko oxygenation activity kehte hain.
Isliye ise RuBP carboxylase-oxygenase kehna zyada sahi hai, aur chhote mein RuBisCO.
Dekho, RuBisCO dharti par sabse zyada paya jaane wala protein hai; har hari patti mein yeh bhara hota hai. O₂ judne se kya nuksaan hota hai, yeh aage photorespiration mein dekhenge.
Dukaan mein yeh naya paisa aane ka kadam hai: har CO₂ ek naya rupaya hai jo poonji ke saath judta hai.
points.screen: Stroma mein paas se: paanch moti wala RuBP aur ek moti wala CO₂ ek-doosre ki taraf; beech mein RuBisCO ka bada protein. Mile to chhe moti ka molecule pal bhar chamakta hai aur turant teen-teen moti ke do 3-PGA mein toot jaata hai; ek sire par 'COOH' aur teesre moti par phosphate ka tag. Naam ke hisse alag-alag chamakte: carboxyl + ation; stable, organic, intermediate; 3 + phospho + glyceric acid. Enzyme par label 'RuBP carboxylase-oxygenase = RuBisCO', aur ek chhota O₂ bhi enzyme ki taraf aata dikhe. Kone mein dukaan ki thaili mein naya rupaya judta hua.

terms.meaning: Molecule par CO₂ se bana carboxyl group (COOH) jodna; yahan RuBP par CO₂ ka judna, Calvin cycle ka pehla kadam.
Tikau (turant na tootne wala), carbon wala, beech ka molecule jo aakhri product nahi; yahan 3-PGA.
3-phosphoglyceric acid: teen carbon ka acid jiske teesre carbon par phosphate hai; figure mein 3-phosphoglycerate.
Enzyme dwara tez karayi gayi (reaction), jisme enzyme khud nahi badalta.
RuBP par CO₂ ki jagah O₂ jodne ki enzyme ki kaabiliyat.
RuBP carboxylase-oxygenase: RuBP par carboxylation bhi aur oxygenation bhi karne wala enzyme.

points.outside_book: RuBP aur CO₂ ka chhe carbon wala pal bhar ka molecule jo turant do 3-PGA mein tootta hai; carboxyl = COOH; RuBisCO dharti ka sabse zyada paya jaane wala protein.

says: Ab 3-PGA ko dhyan se dekho: carbon to isme aa gaya, par yeh abhi sugar nahi, ek acid hai.
Acid ko sugar banane ke liye do cheezein chahiye: thodi energy, aur electron.
Yaad karo, phosphate jodne ko phosphorylation kehte hain, aur ATP apna ek phosphate dekar energy deta hai.
Aur electron, saath mein hydrogen, milne ko reduction kehte hain; NADPH yahi electron aur hydrogen dene wala molecule hai.
Pehle har 3-PGA par ATP ek aur phosphate jod deta hai, aur molecule mein energy bhar jaati hai.
Phir NADPH use electron aur hydrogen deta hai, aur acid wala sira sugar wala sira ban jaata hai.
Ab aap samajh gaye honge ki is kadam ka naam reduction kyun hai: yahan electron milne se hi badlaav hota hai.
Jo banta hai, use triose phosphate kehte hain: tri yaani teen, ose yaani sugar, yaani teen carbon ki sugar jis par phosphate laga hai.
Yahi is chakkar ki asli sugar hai. Ise banane mein kai reactions ek ke baad ek chalti hain, aur yahi series aage glucose banne tak le jaati hai.
Ab kharcha gino: ek CO₂ jodne se do 3-PGA bane the, aur har 3-PGA ko ek ATP aur ek NADPH chahiye.
Toh har pakde gaye CO₂ ke hisaab se is kadam mein 2 ATP aur 2 NADPH lagte hain.
Isi 'har pakde gaye CO₂ ke hisaab se' ko per CO₂ molecule fixed kehte hain.
Ab ek sawaal: CO₂ mein sirf ek carbon hai, aur glucose mein chhe. Toh ek glucose ke liye kitne CO₂ pakadne padenge?
Ek glucose ke liye chhe CO₂ pakadne padenge, kyunki har CO₂ sirf ek carbon laata hai.
Aur chakkar ke ek poore ghumaav mein ek hi CO₂ pakda jaata hai; is ek ghumaav ko turn kehte hain.
Isliye yaad rakho: chhe CO₂ ka fixation, yaani cycle ke 6 turns, milkar ek glucose molecule banate hain.
Dukaan ki tarah socho: maal taiyaar karne mein bijli aur mazdoori lagti hai. Chakkar mein yeh kharcha ATP aur NADPH se chukaya jaata hai.
points.screen: Ek 3-PGA (teen moti, ek sire par COOH, teesre moti par phosphate): pehle ATP aata hai aur ek aur phosphate tag judta hai, ATP se ADP bachta hai; phir NADPH electron aur H deta hai, COOH wala sira sugar ke sire mein badalta hai, NADPH se NADP⁺ bachta hai; ab naam 'triose phosphate' (tri = 3, ose = sugar). Neeche ginti: 1 CO₂ → 2 3-PGA → 2 ATP + 2 NADPH. Phir glucose ke chhe moti, chhe alag CO₂ ke ek-ek moti, aur chakkar ke 6 ghumaav ke gol nishaan. Kone mein dukaan ka bijli-mazdoori ka bill.

terms.meaning: Teen carbon ki sugar jis par phosphate laga hai (tri = teen, ose = sugar); reduction ka product.
Har ek pakde (fix kiye) gaye CO₂ ke hisaab se.
Cycle ka ek poora ghumaav, jisme ek CO₂ fix hota hai; kai ghumaav = turns.

points.outside_book: 3-PGA par pehle ATP se phosphate judta hai, phir NADPH se electron aur hydrogen; acid wala sira sugar wala sira banta hai (triose phosphate).

says: Ab lautte hain us sawaal par jo shuruaat mein chhoda tha: RuBP dobara banta kis cheez se hai?
RuBP kis cheez se banega, iska ek clue hai: chakkar mein bahar se sirf CO₂ aata hai, aur reduction ke baad triose phosphate bante hain.
Ruko, pehle khud socho: RuBP ke paanch carbon aakhir aayenge kahan se?
Aapne socha hoga ki triose phosphate se hi; bilkul sahi.
Dekho, reduction ke baad bane triose phosphate mein se zyadatar wapas chakkar mein lautte hain.
Unke carbon jod-tod kar phir se paanch carbon wale RuBP ban jaate hain.
Isliye is kadam ka naam regeneration hai: wahi regenerated wala shabd, yaani dobara banana.
Jo molecule CO₂ ko pakadta hai, use CO₂ acceptor kehte hain: accept yaani lena, acceptor yaani lene wala.
Yaad karo, light reaction mein primary acceptor electron leta tha; yeh CO₂ acceptor CO₂ leta hai, aur yahan woh RuBP hai.
Is kadam ka kharcha bhi hum gin lete hain: har CO₂ par ek ATP.
Kyunki RuBP mein do phosphate hote hain, bis yaani do, aur doosra phosphate ATP hi jodta hai; yeh bhi phosphorylation hai.
Par yeh kadam itna zaroori kyun hai?
Yeh kadam zaroori isliye hai, kyunki RuBP dobara na bane to agla CO₂ pakadne wala koi nahi bachega.
Tab ATP aur NADPH bhare pade rahenge, phir bhi chakkar ruk jaayega.
RuBP banta rahe to chakkar bina ruke chalta rehta hai; bina ruke chalne ko uninterrupted kehte hain.
Yahi dukaan ka niyam hai: jo dukaandar poonji kha jaaye, uski dukaan agle din nahi khulti.
points.screen: Chakkar ka teesra hissa: sawaal 'RuBP ke paanch carbon kahan se?' ke saath bada '?' aur chhoti ghadi (teen second ruk). Phir reduction ke baad bane chhe triose phosphate (teen-teen moti); paanch wapas chakkar ki taraf mudte hain, unke moti khulkar teen paanch-paanch moti ki RuBP maala ban jaate hain; har maala ke doosre sire par ATP se phosphate tag judta, ATP → ADP. Label 'CO₂ acceptor = RuBP', aur alag chhote dabbe mein light reaction ka 'primary acceptor: electron'. Phir RuBP na bane to aate CO₂ ke teer khaali laut jaate aur chakkar ka teer ruk jaata; RuBP bane to teer lagaataar ghoomta. Kone mein dukaan ka band shutter.

terms.meaning: CO₂ ko lene (accept karne) wala molecule; Calvin cycle mein RuBP. Light reaction ke electron lene wale primary acceptor se alag.
Bina ruke, lagaataar chalne wala.

points.outside_book: Paanch triose phosphate ke 15 carbon jod-tod se teen RuBP ke 15 carbon bante hain; RuBP ka doosra phosphate ATP jodta hai (bis = do).

says: Chalo, ab gin kar dekhte hain ki chakkar sach mein poora ghoom kar band hota hai ya nahi.
Hisaab aasaan rahe, isliye teen CO₂ lekar chalte hain.
Socho, teen RuBP hain, har ek mein paanch carbon: kul pandrah carbon.
Teen CO₂ aaye, har ek mein ek carbon, toh ab kul athaarah carbon ho gaye.
Carboxylation ke baad yeh athaarah carbon chhe 3-PGA mein bante hain, har ek mein teen.
Reduction ke baad yahi chhe triose phosphate ban jaate hain; carbon abhi bhi athaarah hi hain.
Ab batao, inme se kitne triose phosphate wapas jaayenge, aur kitne bahar?
Wapas paanch triose phosphate jaayenge, aur bahar sirf ek.
Paanch triose phosphate ke pandrah carbon jod-tod kar teen RuBP bana dete hain, yaani jitne RuBP the, utne hi wapas.
Bacha ek triose phosphate, teen carbon wala, is chakkar ki asli kamaai hai; yahi sugar banne ke liye bahar nikalta hai.
Dhyan do, yeh teen carbon wahi hain jo teen CO₂ lekar aaye the. Chakkar ne jitna carbon pakda, utna hi bahar diya.
Chhe CO₂ par yahi hisaab do baar chalta hai: do triose phosphate bahar, yaani chhe carbon, ek glucose jitne.
Dukaan mein bhi yahi hota: pandrah rupaye ki poonji, teen naye rupaye, kul athaarah; pandrah wapas thaili mein, aur teen rupaye kamaai.
points.screen: Moti gin kar: teen RuBP maala (5 + 5 + 5 = 15 moti) aur teen CO₂ moti (+3), kul 18. Phir chhe 3-PGA (6 × 3) aur chhe triose phosphate (6 × 3 = 18). Paanch triose phosphate ke 15 moti mud kar teen RuBP maala banate; ek triose phosphate (3 moti) bahar 'kamaai' ki taraf. Neeche ginti: 15 + 3 = 18 → 15 wapas + 3 bahar. Phir chhe CO₂ wala chitra: do triose phosphate bahar = 6 moti = ek glucose. Saath mein dukaan ke sikke: ₹15 poonji + ₹3 = ₹18; ₹15 thaili mein, ₹3 kamaai.
points.outside_book: Teen CO₂ par carbon ki ginti: 15 + 3 = 18 carbon, chhe triose phosphate, paanch se teen RuBP, ek bahar; chhe CO₂ par do bahar = ek glucose.

says: Ab Figure 11.8 dekho; isme yahi poora chakkar ek gol raaste ki tarah bana hai.
Upar dekho, likha hai Atmosphere, yaani hawa; wahan se teer isliye aata hai, kyunki CO₂ hawa se hi patti mein aata hai.
Us teer par likha hai CO₂ + H₂O, jo pehle dabbe, 1 Carboxylation, mein jaate hain.
Upar ke dabbe mein likha hai Ribulose-1,5-bisphosphate; yeh RuBP ka poora naam hai.
Naam mein 1,5 isliye hai, kyunki paanch carbon mein se pehle aur paanchve carbon par phosphate lage hain; bis yaani do phosphate.
Carboxylation se teer ghadi ki sui ki disha mein 3-phosphoglycerate tak jaata hai; yeh wahi 3-PGA hai.
Ab ungli aage le chalo: dabba hai 2 Reduction, aur isme andar aate teer par likha hai ATP + NADPH.
Bahar jaate teer par likha hai ADP + Pᵢ + NADP⁺; kharch hone ke baad ATP aur NADPH ke yahi bache roop hain.
Reduction ke baad aata hai Triose phosphate, aur yahan se raasta do mein bant jaata hai.
Neeche ki taraf ka teer kehta hai Sucrose, starch; kamaai wali sugar isi taraf jaati hai.
Doosra raasta 3 Regeneration se hokar lautta hai; yahan ATP andar jaata hai aur ADP bahar aata hai.
Aur teer phir se Ribulose-1,5-bisphosphate par pahunch kar chakkar band kar deta hai.
Figure ke neeche likha hai ki reduction mein carbohydrate, photochemically made ATP aur NADPH ke kharche par banta hai.
Photochemically made yaani roshni wali reactions mein bane hue: photo yaani roshni, chemical yaani rasayanik.
Isliye yeh chakkar roshni ke bina zyada der nahi chal sakta; iska kharcha roshni ki kamaai se hi chalta hai.
points.screen: Figure 11.8 ka saaf, bada chitra; ungli ka nishaan har label par baari-baari: upar Atmosphere aur CO₂ + H₂O ka teer → 1 Carboxylation ke paas Ribulose-1,5-bisphosphate (pehle aur paanchve carbon par phosphate chamakte) → ghadi ki disha mein 3-phosphoglycerate → 2 Reduction (andar ATP + NADPH, bahar ADP + Pᵢ + NADP⁺) → Triose phosphate → neeche Sucrose, starch, aur doosra teer 3 Regeneration (ATP andar, ADP bahar) → wapas Ribulose-1,5-bisphosphate. Aakhir mein figure ke neeche ki line 'photochemically made ATP and NADPH' roshan, saath thylakoid mein roshni se ATP aur NADPH bante dikhane wala chhota chitra.

terms.meaning: Roshni se chalne wali reactions (light reaction) mein bana hua; photo = roshni, chemical = rasayanik.

points.outside_book: Ribulose-1,5-bisphosphate mein 1,5 = pehle aur paanchve carbon par phosphate.

says: Yeh kamaai wali sugar aapko roz ki zindagi mein milti hai.
Patti triose phosphate se sucrose banati hai, jo poore paudhe mein bheji ja sakti hai.
Aapke ghar ki cheeni aur ganne ka meetha ras, dono yahi sucrose hain.
Aur jo sugar turant kaam nahi aati, use paudha starch banakar jama karta hai. Aaloo, chawal aur gehun ka aata zyadatar starch hi hai.
Toh aaloo ka starch aaloo mein bana kaise, jabki aaloo mitti ke neeche andhere mein hai?
Aaloo ka starch patti mein bani sugar se bana: sucrose patti se aaloo tak pahunchi, aur wahan starch banakar jama ho gayi.
Yaad karo, chapter ki shuruaat wale prayog mein patti ke jis hisse ko CO₂ nahi mili, wahan iodine se starch nahi dikha.
Kyunki CO₂ ke bina yeh chakkar chal hi nahi sakta, aur chakkar ke bina na sugar banti hai, na starch.
points.screen: Patti se tane aur jad ki taraf behti sugar ki dhaara (sucrose); ek taraf ganna aur cheeni ki katori, doosri taraf mitti ke neeche aaloo ke andar starch ke daane, saath chawal aur aata. Phir chapter ki shuruaat wala prayog: tube ke andar wala patti ka hissa iodine ke baad bhoora, bahar wala hissa neela-kaala.

terms.meaning: Ganne aur cheeni wali sugar; paudha ise patti se baaki hisson tak bhejta hai.

points.outside_book: Ganne ka ras aur cheeni sucrose hain; aaloo, chawal aur gehun mein starch; aaloo ka starch patti se aayi sucrose se banta hai.

says: Ab poore chakkar ka kharcha jodne se pehle ek baat socho: kya CO₂ ko pakadne mein bhi energy lagti hai?
CO₂ ko pakadne mein koi energy nahi lagti; carboxylation mein na ATP kharch hota hai, na NADPH.
RuBP mein regeneration wale ATP ki energy pehle se bhari hoti hai.
Isliye CO₂ se judna uske liye dhalaan se neeche ludhakne jaisa aasaan hai; RuBisCO bas ise tez karta hai.
Matlab poora kharcha baaki do kadamon mein hai: sugar banane wale reduction mein, aur RuBP ko phir taiyaar karne wale regeneration mein.
Dukaan mein bhi naya paisa aane ka koi kharcha nahi; kharcha maal banane aur poonji sambhalne mein hai.
points.screen: Chakkar ke teen hisse ek line mein: 1 carboxylation par '0 ATP, 0 NADPH', RuBP ki maala ek dhalaan ke upar se CO₂ ki taraf aasaani se ludhakti; 2 reduction par ATP aur NADPH ke moti; 3 regeneration par ATP ka moti, jo RuBP ki maala mein energy bhar kar use dhalaan ke upar pahunchata. Kone mein dukaan: paisa aane par koi bill nahi, maal banane aur thaili sambhalne par bill.
points.outside_book: Carboxylation mein ATP ya NADPH nahi lagta; regeneration ke ATP ki energy RuBP mein rehti hai, isliye CO₂ ka judna apne aap aage badhne wali reaction hai.

says: Ab bill jodo: reduction ke 2 ATP aur regeneration ka 1 ATP milkar har CO₂ par 3 ATP hue, aur NADPH sirf 2.
Yaad karo, seedhe raaste, yaani non-cyclic, mein ATP aur NADPH dono saath-saath bante hain.
Aur gol raaste, yaani cyclic, mein electron PS I se ghoom kar wahin lautta hai, aur sirf ATP banta hai, NADPH nahi.
Ab socho, chakkar ki ATP ki yeh zyada maang kaun poori karta hoga?
ATP ki zyada maang poori karne ke liye hi shayad cyclic phosphorylation hota hai, jo NADPH badhaaye bina sirf ATP deta hai.
Kyunki agar sirf seedha raasta chale, to har ATP ke saath NADPH bhi banega, aur ATP kam pad jaayega.
Yahan cyclic phosphorylation wahi gol raaste wala cyclic photophosphorylation hai, jo humne light reaction mein dekha tha.
points.screen: Bill ki parchi: reduction 2 ATP + 2 NADPH, regeneration 1 ATP; neeche total 3 ATP + 2 NADPH har CO₂ par, tarazu mein ATP ka palda bhaari. Phir thylakoid par do raaste: seedha raasta (PS II → PS I → NADP⁺) ATP aur NADPH dono deta; gol raasta (PS I se ghoom kar wapas PS I) sirf ATP deta. Gol raaste se aata ATP tarazu ko barabar karta.

terms.meaning: Cyclic photophosphorylation: electron PS I se ghoom kar wahin lautta hai aur sirf ATP banta hai, NADPH nahi.

points.outside_book: Sirf seedhe raaste se ATP ke saath NADPH bhi banta hai, isliye 3 : 2 ki maang ke liye ATP kam padta hai.

says: Hum gin chuke hain ki ek glucose ke chhe carbon ke liye cycle ke 6 turns chahiye.
Ab khud nikaalo: ek glucose banane mein kitne ATP aur kitne NADPH lagenge?
Kitne ATP lagenge, iska clue yeh hai ki har turn ka kharcha aapko pata hai; bas use chhe se guna karo.
Har turn mein 3 ATP, toh chhe turns mein 6 × 3 = 18 ATP.
Aur har turn mein 2 NADPH, toh 6 × 2 = 12 NADPH.
Aksar bachche sochte hain ki 12 ATP lagenge, kyunki woh sirf reduction gin lete hain; par asal mein regeneration ke 6 ATP bhi judte hain.
Aur yaad rakho, chhe turns se chhe glucose nahi, milkar ek hi glucose banta hai.
points.screen: Sawaal ka dabba 'Ek glucose = kitne ATP, kitne NADPH?' aur chhoti ghadi. Phir chhe gol chakkar ek line mein, har chakkar ke neeche 3 ATP aur 2 NADPH ke moti; jod: 18 ATP, 12 NADPH. Ek galat jawab '12 ATP' par kaata hua nishaan, aur regeneration ke 6 ATP judkar 18. Aakhir mein chhe chakkar → ek glucose.
points.answer: Ek glucose ke liye 6 turns; har turn mein 3 ATP aur 2 NADPH, toh 6 × 3 = 18 ATP aur 6 × 2 = 12 NADPH (reduction ke 12 ATP + regeneration ke 6 ATP = 18).
points.watch_out: Sirf reduction ginne par 12 ATP aata hai, regeneration ke 6 ATP chhoot jaate hain; aur 6 turns se 1 glucose banta hai, 6 glucose nahi.

says: Yeh sab ek nazar mein dekhna ho, to dekho ki Calvin cycle mein kya andar jaata hai aur kya bahar aata hai.
Andar jaate hain chhe CO₂, aur bahar aata hai ek glucose.
Andar jaate hain 18 ATP, aur bahar aate hain 18 ADP.
Andar jaate hain 12 NADPH, aur bahar aate hain 12 NADP⁺.
ATP aur NADPH kharch hokar ADP aur NADP⁺ ban jaate hain. Yeh thylakoid mein laut kar roshni se phir chaarj ho jaate hain.
Par is hisaab mein RuBP kahin nahi dikhta; kyun?
RuBP hisaab mein isliye nahi dikhta, kyunki jitna lagta hai, utna hi chakkar mein wapas ban jaata hai.
Dukaan ke hisaab mein bhi poonji nahi likhi jaati; sirf kamaai aur kharcha likhe jaate hain.
points.screen: Do khaane ki table: In | Out; Six CO₂ | One glucose; 18 ATP | 18 ADP; 12 NADPH | 12 NADP⁺; har row baari-baari roshan. Side mein ADP aur NADP⁺ ke moti thylakoid ki taraf laut kar roshni mein phir ATP aur NADPH bante. Table ke bahar RuBP ka band gol chakkar jo khud mein ghoomta rehta hai.
points.outside_book: Table mein NADP ko NADP⁺ kaha; RuBP table mein isliye nahi kyunki woh regenerate hota hai.

says: Ab poora chakkar ek saath dohra lo.
Pehle kadam, carboxylation, mein RuBisCO RuBP par CO₂ jodta hai, aur do 3-PGA bante hain.
Doosre kadam, reduction, mein ATP aur NADPH ke kharche se 3-PGA triose phosphate ban jaate hain.
Teesre kadam, regeneration, mein zyadatar triose phosphate ek ATP aur lagakar wapas RuBP ban jaate hain.
Har teen CO₂ par ek triose phosphate kamaai bankar bahar jaata hai, aur usse sucrose aur starch bante hain.
Har CO₂ ka kharcha 3 ATP aur 2 NADPH hai, aur ek glucose ka 18 ATP aur 12 NADPH.
Ab shuru wala sawaal phir se: har CO₂ par ek RuBP kharch hota hai, toh patti ka RuBP khatam kyun nahi hota?
RuBP khatam isliye nahi hota, kyunki jitna RuBP pehle kadam mein lagta hai, utna hi teesre kadam mein wapas ban jaata hai.
Bilkul wahi dukaan jo shuru mein dekhi: poonji roz lagti hai, shaam ko wapas thaili mein aa jaati hai, aur ghar sirf kamaai jaati hai.
Aur yeh chakkar har hare paudhe mein chalta hai, chahe woh C₃ ho ya C₄.
Toh aap poochhoge, agar chakkar sab mein ek hai, to C₄ paudhe alag kis baat mein hain?
C₄ paudhe alag kis baat mein hain, yeh aage hum dekhenge.
points.screen: Figure 11.8 jaisa poora gol chakkar, teeno kadam baari-baari roshan: RuBisCO par RuBP + CO₂ → do 3-PGA; ATP + NADPH se triose phosphate; paanch wapas RuBP, ek bahar sucrose aur starch ki taraf. Neeche parchi: 1 CO₂ = 3 ATP + 2 NADPH; 1 glucose = 18 ATP + 12 NADPH. Phir shuru ka sawaal 'RuBP khatam kyun nahi hota?' laut kar aata hai: pehle kadam mein ek RuBP lagta, teesre kadam mein utna hi RuBP wapas banta; kone mein dukaan ki thaili mein poonji wapas jaati aur kamaai ghar jaati. Aakhir mein do paudhe, C₃ aur C₄, dono ka teer isi chakkar tak, aur C₄ par sawaal ka nishaan jo khula rehta hai.

parts.bridge: Calvin cycle har hare paudhe mein ek hi hai; agle heading mein dekhenge ki C₄ paudhe CO₂ ko is chakkar tak pahunchane ka kaun sa khaas tareeka rakhte hain.
parts.title: The Calvin Cycle

parts.goal: Ab shared Calvin cycle tak C₄ plants ki carbon delivery follow karenge, aur samjhenge ki leaf ki special anatomy is delivery ko kaise support karti hai.

says: Ab shared Calvin cycle tak C₄ plants ki carbon delivery follow karenge, aur samjhenge ki leaf ki special anatomy is delivery ko kaise support karti hai.

Anatomy pehchaanne ke baad process ke chaar steps follow karenge: initial carbon fixation, four-carbon compound ki delivery aur CO₂ release, three-carbon remainder ki return, aur acceptor regeneration.
C₄ oxaloacetic acid wahi pehle pehchaana four-carbon first stable product hai, aur dono groups ka shared Calvin cycle bhi hum jaan chuke hain.
C₄ plants dry tropical regions, yaani garam ilaakon ki paani-kam conditions, ke liye adapted ho sakte hain.
Inka main biosynthetic pathway, yaani organic substances banane wala connected reaction route, Calvin cycle hi hai.
Phir C₃ plants se inka farq kya hai?
Aksar log sochte hain ki C₄ plants Calvin cycle use nahi karte, par asal mein unki initial carbon capture aur delivery alag hai, sugar-making Calvin cycle shared hai.
points.screen: Realistic maize leaf se internal tissue tak zoom; four-carbon oxaloacetic acid entry route ke aage shared Calvin-cycle symbol. Side par chaar numbered steps: fixation, delivery/release, return, regeneration.

terms.meaning: Pehle pehchaana four-carbon oxaloacetic acid; C₄ initial fixation ka first stable product.
Garam tropical ilaake jahaan paani ki availability kam ho sakti hai.
Organic substances banane wali connected reactions ka route.

says: C₄ plants ki paanch khas baatein jodo: special leaf anatomy, higher-temperature tolerance, high light intensities par achchha response, photorespiration ka practically absent hona, aur greater biomass productivity.
Leaf anatomy leaf ke andar tissues aur cells ka arrangement hai.
Photorespiration RuBisCO ki O₂ wali activity se shuru hone wala route hai, jisme fixed carbon aur energy ka loss hota hai; iska detail agle heading mein kholenge.
RuBisCO ki CO₂ aur O₂, dono wali activities hum pehle pehchaan chuke hain.
Productivity of biomass ka matlab fixed time mein naya plant material banne ki rate hai.
Photorespiration ko C₄ plants mein absent kyun maana jaata hai?
Dekho, inka carbon-delivery system RuBisCO ke paas CO₂ badhata hai, jisse photorespiration bahut strongly suppress hoti hai.
Pehle anatomy samjhenge, phir delivery route se in features ka connection jodenge.
points.screen: Maize leaf ke paas paanch features: internal tissue ring, warmth, strong light, suppressed photorespiration aur biomass gain.

terms.meaning: Leaf ke andar tissues aur cells ki banawat aur arrangement.
RuBisCO ki O₂ wali activity se shuru carbon aur energy kharch karne wala route.
Ek fixed time mein naye plant material ke production ki rate.

says: Teacher-prepared vertical sections mein ek C₃ leaf aur ek C₄ maize leaf ko microscope se compare karo.
Vertical section leaf ki upper se lower surface tak thickness ko expose karne wala thin cut hai.
Mesophyll wahi internal photosynthetic tissue hai, jise hum pehle locate kar chuke hain.
Kya dono leaves mein mesophyll ka arrangement aur veins ke aas-paas ke cells ek jaise hain?
Dekho, maize mein vein ke around prominent large-cell ring dikhti hai, aur uske baahar mesophyll arranged hota hai.
C₃ reference section mein yahi characteristic C₄ ring organisation nahi milti.
Mesophyll ke layers bhi compare karo, lekin har C₃ leaf mein ek jaisi layer differentiation maan lena sahi nahi hai.
points.screen: Side-by-side realistic microscopic C₃ reference aur maize vertical sections; vein-surrounding cells aur outer mesophyll highlighted.

terms.meaning: Leaf ki upper se lower surface tak thickness dikhane wale thin cuts.

points.outside_book: C₃ leaves mein mesophyll differentiation ki variation ko clarify kiya.
points.answer: Maize section mein characteristic prominent sheath ring aur surrounding mesophyll organisation milti hai; har C₃ leaf ka mesophyll identical nahi hota.
points.watch_out: Ek reference C₃ section ki layering ko sabhi C₃ species ka compulsory pattern na maano.

says: Socho, ek central stand ke chaaron taraf flowers ki wreath, yaani gol maala, lagi hai.
Har flower central stand ko gherne wale ring ka hissa hai; isi surrounding arrangement ko leaf mein pehchaano.
Vascular bundles leaf ki veins ke andar water aur food transport karne wale xylem–phloem groups hain.
In bundles ko gherne wale cells bundle sheath cells kehlaate hain.
Typical C₄ leaf mein particularly large sheath cells ka wreath-like arrangement Kranz anatomy kehlaata hai; Kranz ka meaning wreath hai.
Yahaan central stand vascular bundle hai, aur flower-ring large bundle sheath cells hain.
Kranz naam leaf ke baahari shape ko kyun nahi batata?
Dekho, naam internal cells ki bundle ko gherne wali arrangement se aaya hai, poori leaf ki outline se nahi.
points.screen: Circular flower wreath ke saath realistic maize vein cross-section; centre vascular bundle aur surrounding large bundle sheath cells matched.

terms.meaning: Xylem aur phloem ke transport groups jo leaf veins ke andar hote hain.
Vascular bundle ko chaaron taraf gherne wale cells.
Typical C₄ leaf mein vascular bundle ke around large sheath cells ki wreath-like organisation.

points.outside_book: Xylem–phloem ka basic transport role prerequisite ke roop mein khola.
points.answer: Central stand vascular bundle hai; flower wreath surrounding large bundle sheath cells ka spatial arrangement hai.
points.watch_out: Wreath sirf arrangement samjhati hai; bundle sheath cells flowers nahi hain aur unke biochemical functions analogy se explain nahi hote.

says: Bundle sheath ki ring mein several layers ho sakti hain, lekin multiple layers compulsory nahi hain.
In cells mein numerous chloroplasts, thick walls aur cells ke beech intercellular spaces ki absence khas features hain.
Intercellular spaces neighbouring cells ke beech ki khaali jagahen hain.
Walls ko impervious to gaseous exchange kehte hain, yaani gases ka freely aar-paar jaana strongly restricted hota hai.
Gas escape restrict karna useful kyun hoga?
Dekho, sheath ke andar delivered CO₂ retain hogi, aur numerous chloroplasts ke stromal reactions us carbon ko use kar sakenge.
Chloroplast stroma ka sugar-making role hum pehle samajh chuke hain.
points.screen: Wahi realistic maize section enlarged: tightly packed sheath cells, many chloroplasts, thick walls aur restricted outward CO₂ arrows.

terms.meaning: Paas ke cells ke beech ki khaali jagahen.
Gases ke freely cross karne ko strongly restrict karne wala.

says: Ab maize aur sorghum ke teacher-prepared thin leaf sections mein Kranz anatomy identify karo.
Pehle vascular bundle locate karo, phir uske around large chloroplast-rich sheath aur baahar mesophyll cells trace karo.
Mesophyll cells wahi leaf ke internal photosynthetic tissue ke cells hain, jinhe hum pehle pehchaan chuke hain.
Sorghum ke section mein bhi kya isi organisation ko dhoondhoge?
Dekho, dono named C₄ examples mein bundle, surrounding specialised sheath aur outer mesophyll ka relationship match karna hai.
Result sirf green cells dekhna nahi, balki unki organised positions pehchaanana hai.
points.screen: Maize aur sorghum prepared sections; har sample mein vascular bundle → bundle sheath → mesophyll ke nested highlights.

says: Ab aas-paas ki diverse plant species ki leaves collect karke labels lagao, aur teacher se unke thin vertical sections prepare karwao.
Microscope mein har section ka vascular bundle, sheath ke cells aur mesophyll distribution record karo.
Observation sheet mein maize aur sorghum ko characteristic Kranz organisation wale samples ke roop mein rakho.
Kya kisi bhi bundle sheath ka milna C₄ hone ka proof hai?
Dekho, C₃ leaves mein bhi bundle sheath ho sakti hai; characteristic large, chloroplast-rich Kranz organisation ko pehchaanana zaroori hai.
Sirf external leaf shape ya plant ka garam jagah ugna pathway establish nahi karta; internal organisation zyada informative evidence deti hai.
points.screen: Filled observation sheet: maize—Kranz; sorghum—Kranz; reference C₃ section—characteristic Kranz absent; saath corresponding tissue micrographs.
points.outside_book: C₃ plants mein bhi bundle sheath ho sakne ki clarification di.
points.answer: Sections mein specialised Kranz arrangement compare karna hai; sheath ki simple presence ya external morphology decisive nahi hai.
points.watch_out: Har vein-surrounding sheath ko Kranz kehne se C₃ leaves ko bhi galti se C₄ classify kar doge.

says: Bazaar ka bhutta maize crop se aata hai, aur jowar ki roti sorghum ke grain se banti hai.
In dono food crops ki leaves mein yahi microscopic organisation carbon delivery support karti hai.
Higher-temperature tolerance aur strong-light performance inki farming se jude physiological features hain.
Kya in crops ko har environment mein sabse zyada yield milegi?
Dekho, actual harvest paani, light aur doosri growing conditions par bhi depend karta hai, isliye C₄ adaptation universal yield guarantee nahi hai.
points.screen: Bhutta aur jowar ki roti ke saath maize aur sorghum fields; crop leaves se Kranz tissue ka connection.
points.outside_book: Food connections aur C₄ advantage ko universal yield guarantee se alag kiya.

says: Ab Figure 11.9 ka Hatch and Slack Pathway chaar steps mein follow karenge: initial fixation, four-carbon compound ki delivery aur CO₂ release, three-carbon return, aur acceptor renewal.
Hatch and Slack Pathway C₄ carbon-capture aur delivery route ka doosra naam hai.
Yeh cyclic process hai, kyunki starting acceptor dobara available hota hai; acceptor renewal ka logic Calvin cycle mein bhi dekha tha.
Dono cycles ka acceptor kya same hoga?
Dekho, Calvin cycle ka acceptor RuBP tha, lekin is initial delivery cycle ka acceptor ab alag pehchaanenge.
points.screen: Realistic adjacent mesophyll aur bundle sheath cell cutaways; chaar numbered steps: fixation, delivery/release, return, renewal.

terms.meaning: C₄ plants ka initial carbon-capture, delivery aur acceptor-renewal route.
Aisa connected reaction route jisme starting working component dobara milta hai.

says: Mesophyll mein primary acceptor phosphoenol pyruvate, ya PEP, three-carbon molecule hai.
PEP carboxylase, ya PEPcase, initial carbon fixation catalyse karta hai, aur four-carbon OAA banta hai.
OAA wahi pehle khola oxaloacetic acid hai; carbon ledger three plus one equals four hai.
Figure mein incoming inorganic carbon HCO₃⁻, bicarbonate, ke roop mein dikhta hai; PEPcase isi form ko use karta hai.
Is typical C₄ arrangement ke mesophyll cells mein PEPcase hai, lekin RuBisCO nahi hai.
Aksar log sochte hain ki C₄ ka primary acceptor four-carbon hoga, par asal mein PEP three-carbon acceptor aur OAA four-carbon product hai.
Acceptor aur enzyme ko alag kyun rakhna hai?
Dekho, PEP carbon skeleton receive karta hai, jabki PEPcase reaction catalyse karta hai; enzyme ko three-carbon acceptor kehna galat hoga.
points.screen: Wahi mesophyll cutaway: atmospheric CO₂ se HCO₃⁻, phir PEP ke three carbon beads mein one carbon add hokar OAA four beads; PEPcase label.

terms.meaning: C₄ initial fixation ka three-carbon acceptor molecule.
PEP aur bicarbonate se initial four-carbon product banane wali reaction ka enzyme.
Pehle pehchaane oxaloacetic acid ka short name; four-carbon first stable product.
Bicarbonate ion; PEPcase ko milne wala inorganic carbon ka form.

points.outside_book: PEPcase ke actual bicarbonate substrate ko figure ke HCO₃⁻ label se clarify kiya.

says: Mesophyll mein OAA se malic acid ya aspartic acid jaise other four-carbon compounds bante hain.
In four-carbon organic acids ko yahaan C₄ acids keh rahe hain; yeh captured carbon neighbouring bundle sheath cells tak transport karte hain.
Sheath mein inka breakdown CO₂ release karta hai aur three-carbon remainder deta hai; CO₂ nikalne ko decarboxylation kehte hain.
Four carbons ka balance kahaan gaya?
Dekho, four-carbon carrier se one-carbon CO₂ aur three-carbon remainder milta hai, isliye four equals one plus three rehta hai.
points.screen: Same cells par OAA se malic/aspartic acid; four-carbon cargo sheath mein enters, phir one-carbon CO₂ aur three-carbon remainder mein splits.

terms.meaning: Four-carbon compounds jo captured carbon mesophyll se bundle sheath tak pahunchate hain.
Yahaan four-carbon organic acid jo carbon delivery mein kaam aata hai.
Kisi compound se CO₂ release hona.

says: Ab three-carbon remainder bundle sheath se mesophyll mein return hota hai, jahaan usse PEP dobara banta hai.
Regeneration ka meaning wahi starting working molecule ka renewal hai; yahaan renew hone wala acceptor PEP hai, RuBP nahi.
Kya return route ko free carbon recycling samajh sakte hain?
Dekho, PEP renewal energy maangta hai, isliye carbon-concentrating system ka extra energy bill bhi hota hai.
Typical C₄ accounting mein har delivered CO₂ ke liye two additional ATP equivalents lagte hain.
points.screen: Same cell cutaways par three-carbon return arrow aur mesophyll mein PEP regeneration; energy badge: +2 ATP equivalents per CO₂.
points.outside_book: PEP regeneration ka extra cost: two ATP equivalents per CO₂; commonly ATP-to-AMP conversion ki energy accounting.

says: Bundle sheath mein released CO₂ ab C₃ ya Calvin pathway ko feed karti hai.
RuBisCO ke through RuBP carboxylation ka reaction hum pehle follow kar chuke hain.
Yahaan CO₂ preliminary four-carbon compound ki decarboxylation se milti hai; Calvin cycle CO₂ release nahi karti.
Calvin cycle mein fixed carbon ka net output triose phosphate sugar ke roop mein nikalta hai.
Aksar log sochte hain ki initial C₄ fixation hi sugar-making Calvin cycle ko replace karti hai, par asal mein yeh usse concentrated CO₂ supply karti hai.
Do fixation events ko kyun alag pehchaanenge?
Dekho, pehla event carbon delivery ke liye capture karta hai, aur doosra shared Calvin pathway mein carbohydrate formation ko feed karta hai.
points.screen: Same bundle sheath cutaway par four-carbon compound se released CO₂ ka arrow chloroplast stroma ke Calvin-cycle inset tak; net triose-phosphate output alag highlighted.

says: Figure 11.9 mein upper Mesophyll cell ki outer Cell wall aur uske andar Plasma membrane, cell ki selective boundary, identify karo.
Atmospheric CO₂ ka arrow HCO₃⁻ tak, phir Phosphoenol-pyruvate ke saath Fixation box tak follow karo.
Fixation se C₄ acid aur downward Transport arrow bundle sheath ki taraf jaate hain; Plasmodesmata neighbouring cells ko jodne wale channels hain.
Lower Bundle sheath cell mein incoming C₄ acid Decarboxylation box tak pahunchta hai.
Ek branch CO₂ se Fixation by Calvin cycle tak, aur doosri C₃ acid se upward Transport tak jaati hai.
Returned C₃ acid mesophyll mein Regeneration se Phosphoenol-pyruvate ko renew karta hai.
Dono Transport labels opposite directions kyun dikhate hain?
Dekho, downward route four-carbon delivery hai, jabki upward route three-carbon skeleton ki return hai.
points.screen: Ab tak built realistic two-cell pathway par Figure 11.9 ke teaching labels sequentially highlighted; active branch bright, earlier arrows subdued.

terms.meaning: Cell ki selective boundary jo substances ke passage ko regulate karti hai.
Neighbouring plant cells ke interiors ko jodne wale fine channels.

points.outside_book: Plasma membrane aur plasmodesmata ke basic meanings prerequisite ke roop mein khole.

says: Ab enzyme-location map complete karo: C₄ mesophyll mein PEPcase aur bundle sheath mein abundant RuBisCO hota hai.
Is arrangement ke bundle sheath cells mein PEPcase nahi hota; initial capture aur Calvin fixation ki jobs spatially separated hain.
C₃ leaves mein Calvin pathway mesophyll cells mein chalta hai, jabki typical C₄ leaf mein woh bundle sheath cells tak restricted hai.
Same Calvin pathway hone par location ka difference important kyun hai?
Dekho, four-carbon compounds CO₂ sheath mein release karte hain, isliye RuBisCO aur Calvin cycle wahin rakhne se delivered CO₂ seedhe use ho sakti hai.
Dono groups sugars ke precursors shared Calvin pathway se banate hain; difference uski identity mein nahi, carbon supply aur cellular location mein hai.
points.screen: Two-column enzyme-location matrix: C₃ mesophyll—RuBisCO/Calvin; C₄ mesophyll—PEPcase, bundle sheath—RuBisCO/Calvin; corresponding tissue cells highlighted.

says: Ab maize ke ek incoming carbon ko follow karo: bicarbonate ka carbon three-carbon PEP ke saath four-carbon OAA ke account mein judta hai.
Malic-acid delivery ke baad sheath mein one-carbon CO₂ release hoti hai aur three-carbon skeleton mesophyll lautkar PEP renew karta hai.
Starting three-carbon acceptor pool wapas mila; net delivered carbon kitna raha?
Dekho, ek incoming carbon Calvin cycle ko mila, jabki delivery skeleton regenerate hua; delivery loop khud extra carbon create nahi karta.
Six delivered CO₂ ke liye Calvin cycle ka pehle joda bill eighteen ATP aur twelve NADPH hai.
Typical C₄ delivery ke twelve extra ATP equivalents jodne par glucose-equivalent ka total thirty ATP equivalents aur twelve NADPH hota hai.
Yeh energy investment CO₂ concentration ke liye hai; C₄ naam ka matlab four CO₂ molecules ek saath fix hona nahi.
points.screen: Same maize two-cell picture par one marked carbon ka route; side ledger: 3C pool restored, 1C delivered; six-CO₂ energy ledger 18 + 12 = 30 ATP equivalents, 12 NADPH.
points.outside_book: Typical C₄ extra ATP cost ko Calvin budget se jodkar glucose-equivalent energy ledger derive kiya.

says: Socho, phir aage badhenge: four-carbon compound sheath mein CO₂ chhod de, lekin three-carbon remainder mesophyll lautna band ho jaaye, toh continuous delivery ka kya hoga?
Kya sheath mein Calvin cycle hone se missing return route apne-aap theek ho jaayega?
Dekho, return rukne par PEP acceptor pool renew nahi hoga, isliye initial capture aur sustained CO₂ delivery ghatengi, chahe sheath ki Calvin machinery present ho.
Delivery loop aur Calvin cycle alag acceptors renew karte hain; ek ki renewal doosre ki missing regeneration ko replace nahi karti.
points.screen: Same two-cell pathway mein return arrow blocked; mesophyll PEP pool dwindles, sheath Calvin-cycle inset still present.
points.answer: Three-carbon return ke bina PEP renewal fail hogi; finite initial acceptor pool use hone ke baad sustained capture aur delivery nahi chal sakegi.
points.watch_out: Calvin cycle RuBP renew karta hai, PEP nahi; dono acceptor pools ko ek samajhna galat hai.

says: Poora route phir jodo: Kranz leaf mein mesophyll large chloroplast-rich bundle sheath ko surround karta hai, aur sheath vascular bundle ko gherati hai.
Mesophyll ka PEPcase three-carbon PEP ke saath incoming inorganic carbon fix karke four-carbon OAA banata hai.
Malic ya aspartic acid carbon sheath tak laata hai; decarboxylation one CO₂ aur three-carbon remainder deti hai.
CO₂ sheath ke RuBisCO aur Calvin cycle ko feed karti hai, jabki remainder mesophyll lautkar energy-dependent PEP renewal karta hai.
Is arrangement se growth ko fayda kyun mil sakta hai?

Dekho, CO₂ RuBisCO ke paas concentrate hoti hai aur photorespiratory loss suppress hota hai, isliye comparatively few Calvin-performing sheath cells bhi productive carbon assimilation support kar sakte hain.
Ab O₂ wali competing RuBisCO activity ka poora carbon aur energy consequence samjhenge.
points.screen: Same completed realistic tissue-to-two-cell picture, ek waqt mein capture, delivery, Calvin use aur return branches highlighted; final net carbon-gain badge.

parts.bridge: C₄ delivery RuBisCO ke paas CO₂ badhati hai; ab photorespiration mein dekhenge ki O₂ wali reaction ka loss kya hai aur concentrated CO₂ usse kaise rokti hai.
parts.title: THE C₄ PATHWAY

parts.goal: Ab RuBisCO ki O₂ wali reaction ka carbon aur energy loss samjhenge, aur dekhenge ki C₄ ki concentrated CO₂ supply is loss ko kaise dabaati hai.

says: Ab RuBisCO ki O₂ wali reaction ka carbon aur energy loss samjhenge, aur dekhenge ki C₄ ki concentrated CO₂ supply is loss ko kaise dabaati hai.
Yahaan teen links follow karenge: gases ki competition, oxygenation ka carbon–energy account, aur C₄ plants ka protective CO₂ concentration.
Normal carboxylation ka pehle joda reference yaad karo: RuBP + CO₂ se RuBisCO ki madad se two 3PGA molecules bante hain.
RuBP wahi five-carbon acceptor aur 3PGA wahi three-carbon PGA hai; 2 × 3PGA ka matlab do molecules, har ek mein three carbons.
Comparison ka baseline kya hai?
Dekho, five plus one se six carbons, yaani three plus three, milte hain; ab gas badalne par isi account ko compare karenge.
points.screen: Realistic chloroplast-stroma close-up: RuBisCO ke paas familiar carboxylation arrow, RuBP 5C + CO₂ 1C → 2 × 3PGA, total 6C; oxygenation branch abhi nahi.

terms.meaning: 3PGA ke do molecules; har molecule mein teen carbon atoms.

says: RuBisCO duniya ka most abundant enzyme hai; photosynthetic carbon fixation ki enormous demand ke liye plants mein iski bahut badi total quantity milti hai.
Itna enzyme kyun chahiye?
Dekho, bahut bade scale par carbon fixation hoti hai aur RuBisCO comparatively slow catalyst hai, isliye considerable enzyme investment chahiye.
Active site enzyme ka reaction karane wala region hai; RuBisCO ke isi catalytic region par CO₂ aur O₂ alternative reactions mein participate kar sakte hain.
Ek enzyme dono gases ke saath kaise kaam kar sakta hai?
Dekho, enzyme specificity hamesha absolute nahi hoti; RuBisCO ki catalytic chemistry RuBP ke saath dono alternative gas reactions allow karti hai.
Carboxylase-oxygenase naam wahi pehle kholi dual activity batata hai; affinity kisi molecule se judne ka jhukaav hai.
points.screen: Ussi stromal RuBisCO ka enlarged active site; RuBP present, CO₂ aur O₂ ke alternative entry arrows, dono ek saath reaction karte hue nahi.

terms.meaning: Enzyme ka region jahaan substrate ki catalysed reaction hoti hai.
Kisi molecule ke saath judne ka jhukaav.

points.outside_book: RuBisCO ki abundance samjhaane ke liye comparatively slow catalysis aur enzyme specificity ka non-absolute hona joda.

says: CO₂ aur O₂ ki concentrations comparable hon, toh RuBisCO ka jhukaav CO₂ ki taraf kaafi zyada hota hai.
Agar yeh preference na hoti, toh kya hota?
Dekho, comparable concentrations par oxygenation ko zyada opportunity milti aur productive carbon fixation ka advantage kam hota.
Binding competitive hai, yaani dono gases alternative reactions ke liye compete karti hain.
Relative concentration ka matlab ek gas ki concentration doosri ke mukaable kitni hai; CO₂:O₂ isi concentration ratio ko likhta hai.
Aksar lagta hai ki greater CO₂ affinity O₂ binding ko impossible bana degi, par asal mein reaction balance local gas concentrations par bhi depend karta hai.
CO₂ kam hone par O₂ wali reaction ka relative chance badh sakta hai.
points.screen: Same active-site view: pehle comparable gas concentrations, phir CO₂ particles kam; carboxylation aur oxygenation arrows ki relative widths badalti hain.

terms.meaning: CO₂ aur O₂ ka alternative RuBisCO reactions ke liye muqaabla.
Ek substance ki concentration doosre ke mukaable kitni hai.
CO₂ concentration ka O₂ concentration se ratio.

says: Socho, ek service counter par do queues se candidates aa rahe hain, aur clerk ek waqt par ek candidate process karta hai.
Clerk ko pehli queue ko preference dene ki aadat hai, lekin us queue se log aana bahut kam ho jaayein.
Kya preference hone se doosri queue ki service bilkul band rahegi?
Dekho, available candidates badalne par doosri queue ko bhi zyada turns mil sakte hain.
